games.name: Aha... Oh No.

When the truth clicks, the chills begin.

What looked ordinary a moment ago may not stay that way.

You know that feeling: something seems off, but you cannot quite say what it is. At first, noticing the change feels satisfying. Then the meaning sinks in—and a chill runs down your spine.

This is an Aha-style visual horror puzzle built around subtle changes in everyday photographs. Watch closely as a familiar scene slowly becomes something else. The further you go, the more unsettling the world around you may feel.

How to play:
・Watch the photograph carefully
・Notice the area that gradually changes
・Tap the spot where the change occurred

No complicated controls—just your eyes, your instincts, and the courage to keep looking. Each discovery brings a small rush of insight, followed by the uneasy feeling that you may have been better off not knowing.

Perfect for a quick scare during a spare moment, whether you enjoy visual puzzles, eerie games, or that irresistible “just one more” feeling. Test your powers of observation and see if you can handle what you uncover.

How much can you really remember when every detail counts?

A complex illustration packed with items appears before you. Study its placement, colors, shapes, and tiny details, then commit as much as possible to memory.

• Memorize as much information as you can
• Answer a four-choice quiz using memory alone

Created as a compact and physical VR experience, I’m Having a Bad Day is a cartoon-style game built around a simple idea: breaking things can be fun.

You play as a contestant in a fictional reality show set across different environments. The goal is simple: smash, dismantle, and create as much controlled chaos as possible within a short time limit.

Objects react with exaggerated cartoon physics and clear visual feedback. Power-ups, such as oversized tools or jelly weapons, temporarily shift the pace and encourage different approaches to destruction.

I’m Having a Bad Day is a straightforward, physics-driven VR game built around short bursts of action and repeatable levels, created for players who enjoy quick sessions and physical interaction in virtual space.

During your journey you will meet new friends with extraordinary powers to aid you, as well as unlock new powers of your own.

The puzzles are laid out in an interconnected open world, so you have freedom to explore. It is possible to reach the end of the game without completing the most challenging puzzles, so you can enjoy the game casually. However, there are special endings if you are a puzzle master attempting the daunting task of 100% completion.

Brimming with surprises and secrets, you will relive the nostalgia of retro favorites while experiencing a totally new take on a classic puzzle genre!

KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC) tells the power of friendship as Sora and his friends embark on a perilous adventure. Set in a vast array of Disney worlds, KINGDOM HEARTS follows the journey of Sora, a young boy and unknowing heir to a spectacular power.

Through the power of positivity and friendship, Sora, Donald and Goofy unite with iconic Disney-Pixar characters old and new to prevail tremendous challenges and persevere against the darkness threatening their worlds.

games.name: Manairons
games.summary: The Manairons are back… and this time, they’re not staying quiet! Manairons is a 3D action platformer game set in the Pyrenees, where ancient legends mix with smoking factories, mischievous magic, and quirky little creatures. You are Nai, a manairó who has just awakened from centuries locked in the ""canut"", a magical artifact as old as it is suspicious. A witch frees you (very timely, indeed) and gives you a mission: recover the "canut" and stop the chaos it’s causing. The culprit? Llorenç, a landowner with zero charisma and a lot of machines. He’s used the power of the manairons to industrialize the peaceful village of Vilamont. Shops are closed, people are hiding at home, and your fellow manairons are working as if there’s no tomorrow… This is not what the legends said! But Nai isn’t going to sit back. With the help of ancient magical melodies (and a few poorly played notes), you’ll control your fellow manairons, solve puzzles that’ll make you scratch your head, and face your own kind who are working for Llorenç—all with the flute! Adventure, action, stressed-out little creatures, and more than a few hidden secrets await you in the mountains. And remember: when a manairó gets mad… it’s best to step aside. games.name: Order of the Sinking Star
games.summary:
From legendary director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness) comes Order of the Sinking Star, a massive narrative adventure featuring more than one thousand hand-crafted puzzles designed to put your intellect to the test. 

As Queen Effia, you are transported to a realm of curious magic, dangerous contraptions, and vicious monsters. As you make your way, you will explore four distinct worlds, each with its own mechanics, characters, and stories, and then watch as they all collide.

As the worlds merge, and characters meet one another, puzzle systems intertwine, creating surprising new gameplay possibilities. Explore at your own pace, revisit worlds and return to challenges as you see fit. Discover unique playable characters, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher the deep mysteries of a sprawling, interconnected game world.

• Check the picture and word

games.name: Rainbow Islands Console Selection
games.summary:
Rainbow Islands is an arcade action game released by Taito in 1987 where the player controls Bubby or Bobby, using their rainbow magic as both weapons and platforms to climb and reach the goal at the highest point of each stage.

Rainbow Island CS is a collection of several home ports of the arcade game Rainbow Islands.

In addition to the popular 8 and 16-bit versions, the collection includes the never-released-on-cartridge MegaDrive/Genesis version. With 24 quick-save/load slots for each version and a feature that displays the location of the diamonds, there's never been a better time to experience it. It also includes a feature that lets you start the game in a powered-up state.

The PC Engine version is based on the NES version and features a main theme arranged for FM sound by Yukiharu Urita, as well as an ending theme composed by Norihiro Furukawa, both Zuntata (Taito's sound team) alumni.

games.name: Silver Pines

As the case begins to reveal a dark past, Walker soon slips into a strange and nightmarish descent beyond his control.

Silver Pines is a survival horror metroidvania set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

A classical Solitaire game with a relaxing lofi twist. Play classic Solitaire in a exciting, anime-inspired world.

Play classic Klondike Solitaire in 1-card or 3-card draw mode, focusing on clean moves, smart decisions, and a satisfying flow. Each completed game rewards you with score and experience, based on how efficiently you play.

As you gain experience, you level up and unlock cosmetic rewards. These include beautiful anime-style card skins, serene backgrounds inspired by cherry blossoms and temples, and stylish card backs. Every single card has multiple skins and can be customized individually.

Before each match, you can freely adjust your deck and table to match your mood. Whether you prefer soft pastel tones, detailed anime illustrations, or a more minimal look, every game feels personal and relaxing.

games.name: Zodiac 2: Aggres
games.summary:
A 1986 classic is reborn. Dive into a gripping sci-fi mystery to find your missing father and the "Blue Crystal" alongside your sharp-tongued partner, Mary.

Released in 1986 by Riverhill Soft, this title is a profound sci-fi mystery that follows a young man—the son of a space archaeologist—and his nagging, antique-loving robot partner, "Amaroid Marie," as they track down the mystery of his missing father.

The story begins five years after the protagonist's father, Dr. Dumas, a leading authority in space archaeology, vanished during a research expedition. Refusing to believe he is gone, the protagonist makes a meager living as a freight hauler while scouring the far reaches of the galaxy for clues alongside Marie.

Though they once survived a life-or-death struggle on a forbidden, dormant planet while chasing the energy of the "Blue Crystal"—a mysterious artifact fragment once embedded in his father’s right arm—the definitive truth remains out of reach, leaving the protagonist in a state of growing frustration.

This stalemate is shattered by a single radio news broadcast. Jason Cannack, a man who served as the doctor’s assistant but fled with stolen research immediately after the disappearance, has been appointed as the new director of the City Library. Sensing a breakthrough, the protagonist’s intuition turns to certainty: "He must know my father's secret."

games.name: Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen
games.summary:
Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen enriches the dynamic fantasy world and expansive adventures of Dragon's Dogma 2 with unforgettable new tales and thrilling encounters.
    Based on feedback we received after the initial release of Dragon's Dogma 2, we established three goals for ourselves when we set out to update and expand the game:
    Enhanced gameplay. Expanded adventures. Enticing value.

games.name: HORSE CLUB Ride West
games.summary: The HORSE CLUB is visiting the Wild River Ranch! Travel with your friends Hannah, Sofia, Sarah, and Lisa to the Wild West. Explore the vast landscape, help old and new friends, experience exciting adventures on horseback, and win the crown at the Western riding tournament!

games.name: Kemco RPG Selection Vol. 11
games.summary:
Enjoy 4 fantasy adventures at once!

Now you can enjoy 4 RPGs; Alphadia Neo, Heirs of the Kings, Onigo Hunter, Isekai Rondo in one package!

games.name: My Lovey-Dovey Demon
games.summary: A cute love story between a young man and an affectionate, adoring, utterly insatiable demon girl set in the Japanese countryside.

games.name: PARCEL INSPECTION SIMULATOR
games.summary:
Inspect every parcel and keep the deliveries moving.

Welcome to Parcel Inspection Simulator, where every package tells a story — and every detail matters. Step into the role of an inspector responsible for keeping the flow of parcels moving smoothly.

From small envelopes to large shipments, dozens of packages pass through your hands each day. Check documents, inspect deliveries, and make sure everything reaches the right destination. Stay sharp, work efficiently, and turn a small inspection point into a thriving logistics operation.

Key Features:
• Receive and Sort Parcels – Manage the full parcel workflow: accept shipments, sort them correctly, and prepare them for the next stage of processing.
• Inspect Documents Carefully – Verify sender and recipient information, identify incorrect data, and prevent costly mistakes.
• Multiple Inspection Methods – Use different tools and checking methods to ensure every parcel meets the correct requirements.
• Upgrade Your Workspace – Expand your inspection area, upgrade equipment, and improve your parcel processing system.
• Increasing Workload – Handle more packages and more complex tasks as operations grow busier and more demanding.
• Build an Efficient Operation – Start with a small inspection point and develop it into a well-organized parcel management system.

games.name: Rhythm Roll
games.summary: Roll through a world of rhythm and light in Rhythm Roll! Control a fast-moving ball through stunning levels, each with its own unique visual style and musical genre. Dodge obstacles, stay on the beat, and test your reflexes. Simple to play, but can you master the speed?

games.name: Sesame Street: Friends & Fun
games.summary:
Welcome to Sesame Street! A place to play, laugh and grow.

From the moment you arrive, there’s so much to do. Join Elmo, Tango and the rest of your Sesame Street friends around the neighbourhood!

Walk around with Grover, plant a magical giant beanstalk in Abby’s Garden, find useful tools and rubber ducks in the Community Garden with Bert & Ernie, and work on your number and puzzle skills in Count von Count’s Mansion. Or cook, mix and laugh along with Cookie Monster in his Foodie Truck! Some quests may take a few tries, but you’ll work together to find a way to make the streets a brighter and happier place for everyone.

Make yourself at home! Decorate your house, unlock new mini-games, access exciting new areas of the Street, or throw and unforgettable block party. Spend time with Tango, your cheerful and furry helper or enjoy the whole adventure together with family and friends in local co-op play.

The fun and exploration never ends on Sesame Street!

JOIN THE NEIGHBORHOOD: Create your own character and join Elmo, Tango, Abby and their friends on Sesame Street.

EXPLORE THE STREET: Start at your apartment, stop by Big Bird’s cozy nest, play at the Count’s Mansion, and unlock more places.

BRING EVERYONE TOGETHER: Help the community by going on cooking, photography, and even farming quests solo or in co-op.

DISCOVER AND GROW: Use rewards to decorate your home, unlock new mini-games and access exciting new areas.

TRAVEL WITH TANGO: Take care of Tango just like she’ll take care of you as she helps you get around.

games.name: Sugar Rush Rescue
games.summary:
A tasty, retro co-op adventure.

When best friends Colby and Jack find a forest of candy, they're ready to munch! But while the boys selfishly sample the sweets, Colby's little sister is abducted by a monstrous owl! Now they must navigate a world of confections as they learn to pay attention to what matters most.

Featuring a wide range of obstacles, enemies, and levels to explore, Sugar Rush Rescue is a tasty, retro co-op adventure.

games.name: The Relic: First Guardian
games.summary:
In this action RPG, you embark on a heroic adventure to save the world in the dark as the last guardian. 

The once-prosperous Arsiltus was swallowed up by the void created by the destruction of the great relic and transformed into the land of death. Now your mission is to find the pieces of the broken great relic and close the void. 

You are the last hope of the Arsiltus. Start your journey as a guardian, gather pieces of great relic and close the void. Your adventure will bring Arsiltus into a new era.

games.name: Truckful
games.summary:
Truckful is a single player car delivery adventure game based around completing errands and quests for villagers and uncovering the ancient mystery that surrounds the nearby old forest.

Drive your pickup truck through winding countryside roads, dusty lowlands and small towns. Upgrade the truck, improve its weight and load capacity to make it go faster through all kinds of demanding routes. Pack the bed with fragile & shaky cargo of all shapes and kinds, whether its ice cold fish that needs to be delivered fast, or a classic grandma vase that will put your driving skills to the true test.

The ancient forest on the countryside outskirts is unwelcoming to visitors and often mentioned in local legends and myths. The overwhelming feeling of something lurking in the tree branch shadows is hard to shake off. Face the adversity and uncover its deep roots.

games.name: Wrap House Simulator
games.summary: Welcome to Wrap House Simulator! Run your own wrap shop, chop, grill, and serve in this cooking adventure. Customize your shop, master the grill, and survive the rush solo or co-op with up to 4 players. Keep up with orders, satisfy customers, and build your dream restaurant!

games.name: Alpha Nomos
games.summary:
It's time to wield the beat in Alpha Nomos, a rhythm-action roguelite where every instrument is a weapon and every fight moves to the music. Play as Cello and slice through an army of rogue puppets in a vibrant, melody-twisted world where combat pulses to the soundtrack and timing is everything.

Who knew saving the world could sound this good? Join Cello and her friends as they explore their ruined world, fight murderous puppets, and uncover the mysteries of the powerful force known as music. What caused the destruction of this world? What is music? What is Alpha Nomos? All these answers await Cello as she fights to bring balance back to a corrupted world.

Time your moves to the beat to unleash show-stopping combos and perfectly choreographed chaos. Master the rhythm, gather living sound, and breathe life back into a world that moves to the music you make. Prepare for a run where every strike, every upgrade, and every note pulls you deeper into the song.

games.name: Colorbound
games.summary:
Bring the world around you to life with the power of color in Colorbound, a vibrant palette-platformer. 

Join Anku on a heartfelt journey to reunite his late grandfather’s band by using color to shape the world around you. As you journey, you’ll solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and help a family of musicians come together one last time.

games.name: Time To Wake Up
games.summary: Sometimes, you don't just want tasteful makeup to accent your features!Sometimes, you just want to BLING YOUR FACE!With tons of face jewels, shimmery makeup and elaborate accessories, youcan mix and match to create unique looks! Why settle for off-the-shelf whenyou can have off-the-hook?! From quietly glamorous fashion looks to radicallooks you'll see worn by popstars in a music videos, you'll be able to be asbold as you want to be!

games.name: Just Dance: Decades of Hits
games.summary:
IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE SPANNING 6 DECADES
Each decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Discover it all through the all-new Adventure Mode, a cheerful story-driven journey that has you dancing your way through the decades.

DANCE TO SONGS EVERYONE KNOWS
Celebrate iconic intergenerational hits brought to life with unique choreography, including fan-favorites like:

- "NUEVAYoL" by Bad Bunny
- "Manchild" by Sabrina Carpenter
- "Danza Kuduro" by Lucenzo & Don Omar
- "Turn Down for What" by DJ Snake & Lil Jon
- "Feel Good Inc." by Gorillaz
- "Bye Bye Bye" by *NSYNC
- "Wannabe" by Spice Girls
- "No Scrubs" by TLC
- "It's Tricky" by Run DMC
- "Uptown Girl" by Billy Joel
- "Mamma Mia" by ABBA

games.name: Planet Zoo 2
games.summary:
Build a wilder world in Planet Zoo 2 – the sequel to the beloved zoo simulation game. Let your creativity soar by constructing and managing distinctive zoos around the world, full of awe-inspiring animals, including fully aquatic and flying species for the first time. Plus, take the next step in animal conservation and release your species into customisable, expansive Wildlife Reserves. 

AWE-INSPIRING ANIMALS 
Discover a diverse roster of animal species, each with their own needs & behaviours. New faces join familiar favourites like the African Lion and Western Chimpanzee to create iconic zoo rosters in jaw-dropping detail. 

Construct beautiful habitats for your animals to thrive in as they interact with the world around them in authentic ways. From authentic herding behaviours to grazing on the vegetation you provide for them. Experience a generational leap of animal detail and immersion with incredible natural movements and expressive emotions that bring each animal to life like never before. 

AWESOME AQUATICS 
Prepare your diving suit! Fully aquatic species make a splash in their stunning debut! Build custom spectacular freshwater or saltwater aquariums to home an exciting line-up of delightful swimming animals. A new world beneath the water awaits, filled with colourful shoals of fish, Black-tipped Reef Sharks, Hawksbill Turtles and so many more! 

FREQUENT FLYERS 
Soar to great heights with a diverse mix of bright & brilliant fully flying birds including the vibrant Toco Toucan and majestic Secretary Bird. House your birds in fully customisable aviaries built from barriers, support poles and dynamic mesh covers, allowing them to fly freely and safely. Observe their dynamic behaviours on the ground and in the sky as they glide around unique habitats. 

WILDLIFE RESERVES 
Conservation goes beyond your zoo! Take on global conservation projects and meet specific requirements to release your animals into fully customisable, expansive Wildlife Reserves across the globe in living ecosystems created by you.  

LET YOUR CREATIVITY SOAR 
Build the zoo of your dreams across multiple globe-spanning biomes, with four brand-new scenery themes covering iconic architecture from around the world and five returning themes from the original Planet Zoo, providing you with an expansive library of scenery items to build/create with. 

Effortlessly design your zoos using a range of ready-to-place blueprints or get creative with the Planet franchise’s iconic piece-by-piece construction tools to bring your own ideas to life. 

Delve into every detail with scaling, flexi-colour & easy-to-use pathing systems, together with new foliage and terrain brushes to make grand changes to your zoos and Wildlife Reserves. 

MEANINGFUL MANAGEMENT 
Construct perfect habitats for appealing animals to bring in guests, boosting your zoo’s rating and earning money to fund further expansion. 

Manage day-to-day zoo life as you create immersive spaces for your guests packed with educational opportunities around every corner. Cater to their requirements with a variety of shops and amenities to curate the perfect day out. 

A WILDER WORLD AWAITS 
Join FEN (Fauna and Ecosystems Network) in a fun-filled adventure around the world in Career mode. Build a global network of zoos and Wildlife Reserves and trade animals with other players in Franchise mode or enjoy unlimited creativity in Sandbox mode. 

CONNECTED COMMUNITY 
Discover a world of community content in the Frontier Workshop. Freely explore and download player-created blueprints and creations from across platforms and subscribe to your favourites to place them in your zoos.

games.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide
games.summary: Prepare to be scared! A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom. Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick, combine their unique skills and save Bikini Bottom from total ghostification!

games.name: Valor Mortis
games.summary:
You served Napoleon. You died for Napoleon. You have risen for Napoleon.

You are William, a soldier of the Grande Armée brought back from a battlefield grave. But the Europe you awaken to is not the one you sacrificed for. A mysterious plague now sweeps the continent, and you have been reborn with its corrupting power pulsing through your veins.

Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.

games.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
games.summary:
1499. Paris is engulfed as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.

Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, Trevor Belmont’s successor ventures into the burning streets and the looming castle to hunt down the beasts.

Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation...?

Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow a young Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.

games.name: SHOCKWAVE TRIGGERS
games.summary:
Shockwave Triggers is a vertical scrolling shoot’em up where you’ll choose between 2 pilots – the fast and versatile Amira, whose crystal-sensitive sister has been kidnapped, and the slower but more powerful Turbo B, a mechanic determined to take down the supreme leader of the WW army!

Enjoy anime-style cutscenes and a pumping soundtrack as you blast through 6 unique stages of bullet hell mayhem. Collect crystals from destroyed enemies, initiate shockwaves to cancel incoming projectiles into gems, deploy super attacks and upgrade your ship with character-specific armaments!

Use the shop system to earn new features or buy extra credits, choose from multiple difficulties to suit your playstyle, fill your gallery with unlockable art and use the jukebox feature to enjoy the game’s original soundtrack. Team up for local co-op play, dare to challenge Boss Rush mode and test your skills against online leaderboards!

games.name: Survivor Cells
games.summary: &#x2605 HEADSHOTS, BLOOD, AND GORE! &#x2605&#x2605 ACTION PACKED SNIPER GAME! &#x2605In this action filled sniper game, your mission is to infiltrate a terrorist base, and recover the launch codes of a missing nuke. Will you accomplish the mission?- Multiple backgrounds/environments. - Simple "one tap" controls! - Instense soundtrack. - Head shots, lots of blood, and more! ** WARNING! - THIS GAME CONTAINS EXCESSIVE VIOLENCE AND IS NOT SUITABLE FOR CHILDREN. YOU MUST BE 17+ TO DOWNLOAD THIS APP.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
games.summary:
Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 is the brutal and fast-paced sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun.

Following directly on from the end of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, your duty takes you to new locations in a branching, single-player campaign that effortlessly blends the grimdark Warhammer 40,000 universe with a fast-paced first-person shooter.

Take the fight to never-before-seen worlds and vanquish the foes that lurk there. From the colossal heights of a hive city to the impenetrable mangrove swamps of a jungle, you’ll need to overcome the challenges of each biome to complete your mission.

games.name: 1x1 Street Football: mini soccer PvP
games.summary:
Street Football is a vibrant arcade game where every match turns into a real fight! PvP sports battles, mini football and the spirit of street playgrounds inspired us to create this online game. Here you are a football manager, a goalkeeper, and a striker - in short, a true football star! 

No one will give up the ball without a fight: use spectacular street moves and turn the match around! Mini football has become even more dynamic - our football arcade combines sports techniques with flashy combat finishers.

Play street football, upgrade your heroes and their unique skills, climb through international leagues, and build your career like a true football manager!

games.name: Bluey's Happy Snaps
games.summary:
Explore, have fun and capture your favorite moments with Bluey and Bingo in this photo-powered game. Look out for familiar spots from the show, create your own scrapbook and turn in-game memories into playful moments for real life.

Bluey and Bingo have found Dad's old camera (back from when he was cool). Take it with you around the world of Bluey and snap photos of the games they play and wildlife they discover. Each snapshot is saved to Bluey's scrapbook, where players can keep their favorite moments.

Share the adventure side-by-side! A second player can join in to explore and strike a pose while the main player leads the adventure behind the camera. You can even play with toys together along the way!

games.name: Creepy Tale: Snow Child
games.summary:
Step into the twisted, magical universe of Creepy Tale - a world packed with eerie secrets, original brainteasers, and minigames that'll test your wits, agility, and stealth. To survive, you'll need to leap over deadly traps, dodge sinister foes, and crack puzzles like they're no big deal.

Meet the mysterious - and downright dangerous - inhabitants of the otherworldly realm in this thrilling adventure where questing collides with action, and a gripping story ensures boredom stays far, far away.

games.name: Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown
games.summary: SHAKE a million!This is a homage to the famous App TAMAGO.But now it's time to shake. This brings the worldwide loved TAMAGO experience to an new level. Shake your million!Features:- 12 different eggs- 12 different sounds- a lot of shake funDISCLAIMER: Playing TAMAGO SHAKE too much can cause pain. You will use this app on your own responsibility.

games.name: DESOLUS
games.summary:
Explore a city of Gothic architecture torn between past and future in Desolus, a first person puzzle game.

An enigmatic cataclysm has fractured reality, opening portals which lead to other times. Explore the past and future versions of an expansive city.

Solve Escher-like puzzles through the use of black holes, traveling back and forth through time to make the city’s architecture whole again. Challenge your spatial thinking skills while navigating distorted realities as time becomes increasingly more unstable.

Partner with the city's mysterious guardian to prevent a cataclysm threatening to merge past and future. Unravel a haunting narrative to save the City of Desolus from complete annihilation.

games.name: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 3 Complete Edition
games.summary: Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3, now available for modern systems. Play through authentic moments from the movie in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode, where you can customize your town and even play as Evil Emperor Zurg.

games.name: Disney/Pixar Toy Story: Retro Roundup!
games.summary: Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup! This five-game collection features console and handheld versions of four early Toy Story titles, as well as A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and an overflowing toy chest of behind-the-scenes content. Revisit the ‘90s and early 2000s hits you loved and share these titles with a new generation of Toy Story fans.

games.name: Enshrouded
games.summary: You are Flameborn, last ember of hope of a dying race. Awaken, survive the terror of a corrupting fog, and reclaim the lost beauty of your kingdom. Venture into a vast world, vanquish punishing bosses, build grand halls and forge your path in this co-op survival action RPG for up to 16 players.

games.name: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea
games.summary:
The mist of the Forest of Echoes now covers the land of Teradea, and outside of Bloomfield Village where you were raised, wild wolves appear at night. There are even rumors of a large guardian wolf that rules them all...but you and your best friend are about to change that!

Throwing caution to the wind, you’ll set out on a mission to tame those wolves and end up unlocking a journey far greater than you imagined. Help the Guardian Spirits to revive and revitalize Teradea! Visit the port village of Tidewind to uncover what’s causing the storms there. Trek to the mining village of Quarrytop to get to the bottom of the mystery of the earthquakes that are happening. Then, stay in the once-thriving town and cultural center of Maplehill to revive its fading light and community.

Between your travels, tend your farm, raise animals, harvest crops, and build a life for yourself. Guided by the Harvest Goddess and aided by the friends you’ll make in each of the villages, you’ll find new ways to grow, explore, and lend a hand wherever it’s needed. 

With the support of those you’ve helped - and those who stand beside you - you may discover a way to lift the veil from the Forest of Echoes and let Teradea flourish once more!

games.name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure Friendship Bundle Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
games.summary:
Making new friends is a big adventure. Embark on a cozy adventure with Hello Kitty and Friends and restore an abandoned island to its former glory. Can you solve the mystery hidden within? With the new Friendship Bundle, enjoy the complete adventure with both DLC content packs, City Town and Wheatflour Wonderland. Packed with extra characters, quests, locations, and collectible fun, the bundle delivers over 60 hours of additional gameplay, giving you new areas to explore and dozens of new quests to complete.
With the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition enjoy enhanced features: 

    Embark on your cosy adventure to Friendship Island with higher framerates and smoother visuals 
    Celebrating, customising and crafting never looked so good! Enjoy enhanced resolution on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system 
    Playing with your friends is more fun with CameraPlay! 
    Prefer playing with a mouse? Joy-Con™ mouse support is here.

games.name: House Flipper 2 + Sakura DLC
games.summary:
Clean your worries away with this relaxing renovation simulator! Buy, fix, sell, and become a local legend. Or grab your power tools and build anything from scratch! With the online 2-4 players co-op mode, you can play both in sandbox and story mode together.

Spring has arrived, and the view is stunning! Now you can celebrate the sakura blossoms all year long with a whole range of beautiful, distinct items inspired by Japanese culture. From classic paper walls to Japandi furniture, from traditional painting and ceramics to smart bathrooms… 

This is your chance to have fun with new architectural styles or relax while designing a perfect zen garden!

games.name: It Takes Two
games.summary: FREE for a limited time!! It’s the perfect way for you to master basic addition, subtraction, and multiplication! Mathzilla has 3 levels: Easy, Medium, and Hard. Easy is suitable for young math students to practice. Level Medium and Hard require you to immediately recognize the most promising combinations and solve the puzzles quickly, which are challenging for adults to play!==?? FEATURES ??==? 3 Different Levels of Play: Easy, Medium, and Hard   * Easy - addition and subtraction up to the number 5 (maximum value 10)   * Medium - addition, subtraction, and multiplication up to number 9 (maximum value 81)   * Hard - addition, subtraction, and multiplication up to number 19 (maximum value 361)? 3 different scoreboards? Cute Animations: Animations of King Kong, Roxy, and monkeys are cute, and maintain interest in gameplay.? Math Skill Improvement: kids practice finding answers as quickly as possible.==?? HOW TO PLAY ??==What is the mathematical expression for a value 5? Is it: 3+2? Or it is: 9-4? Unlike most math games, Mathzilla with Roxy the Star asks you to think holistically. Mathzilla challenges you to answer questions containing 3 variables, two numbers, and an operator. This helps you develop the ability to solve problems that involve the logical process of trial and error (useful in solving many non-math problems). More advanced players will immediately recognize the most promising combinations and solve the puzzles quickly.Also fostered by the app is the connection between digits, numbers, and quantities. A "3" can function as a noun and refer to an abstract concept, or a "3" may function as an adjective modifying a noun. Mathzilla demonstrates to young math students that a "3" can stand alone or stand connected to a noun, providing the answer to the question "How many (noun)s."Mathzilla subtly interweaves the concept of equivalence. The given answer to the equation may be a group of seven bananas, stacked three over four. But a group of three and another group of four may not be available on the gameboard. Kids may need to use a group of two bananas and another group of five to solve the equation.==?? games.name: RATATAN
games.summary:
Ratatan is a rhythm roguelike action game that combines rhythm games and side-scrolling action, with online co-op gameplay supporting up to 4 players.

An intense battle unfolds with over 100 characters fighting in a massive melee.

Defeat the enemies by riding the rhythm of Ratatan’s catchy, toe-tapping soundtrack in this delightful, heartfelt adventure!

games.name: Tavern Talk: Complete Edition
games.summary:
Discover the cozy fantasy world of Tavern Talk Complete Edition, the first-ever physical Nintendo Switch release of the beloved visual novel adventure.

This Deluxe Edition includes the full base game along with both the Pirate Palooza and Tempest Tantrum DLC on cartridge, delivering the complete Wayfarer’s Inn experience in one definitive package.

games.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 12
games.summary:
The idea wizards at Jackbox Games are following up on the hit Party Pack 11 with brand-new party games!

The Jackbox Party Pack 12 will include 5 different games designed to take your party to new heights. You’ll find new ways to channel your inner comedian, artist, mind reader, debater, and team captain. Like the true multihyphenate you are! Are you sure you didn’t time-travel from the Renaissance era?  

In true Party Pack fashion, no extra controllers are necessary! Use your smartphones, tablets, or computer browsers to join the game and play along. Got a big group? Additional players can jump into audience mode to influence the game in unique ways.

games.name: The Nightmare Box Vol III
games.summary:
Following the collections of The Nightmare Box Vol. 1 and 2, released in 2025, The Nightmare Box Vol. 3 includes NO-SKIN, Menace from the Deep and Stasis. Digitally published by Feardemic, the titles in The Nightmare Box Vol. 3 will drag you into the depths of fear. 

Meridiem has been responsible for the design and manufacture of this game pack, which aside from the three titles includes a set of three tarot cards to add to the collection of cards from the previous volume.

games.name: Tormented Souls 2
games.summary:
After the events of Wildberger Hospital, Caroline yearns for a normal life with her younger sister, Anna. However, fate has other plans. As Anna falls victim to a mysterious affliction, coughing blood and experiencing blackened eyes and moments of unconsciousness, conventional remedies prove futile. In a desperate bid to save her sister, Caroline must turn to the supernatural.

Caroline Walker is back in the sequel to the award-winning classic survival horror. Stalk the halls of haunting monasteries and other nightmarish locations. Brace yourself to confront terrifying creatures armed only with makeshift weapons as you desperately try to rescue your cursed sister.

games.name: Toy Story: Retro Roundup! / Toy Story 3: Complete Edition
games.summary:
Get all the toys in the toy chest with this double pack, featuring both Toy Story: Retro Roundup! and Toy Story 3 Complete Edition. Play as classic characters as you navigate familiar worlds and take on challenges inspired by the films. Toy Story: Retro Roundup! includes 11 classic games, with both console and handheld versions of four Toy Story games, along with A Bug’s Life. Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings back the fan-favorite 3D adventure for modern consoles.

Toy Story: Retro Roundup!

Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup! This five-game collection features console and handheld versions of four early Toy Story titles, as well as A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and an overflowing toy chest of behind-the-scenes content. Revisit the ‘90s and early 2000s hits you loved and share these titles with a new generation of Toy Story fans.

Toy Story 3 Complete Edition

Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3. The updated game features improved graphics and a few new surprises in store. Play through authentic moments from the movie in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode.

games.name: Wolfsschanze - Operation Gotterdammerung
games.summary: Find words in the jumbled up letters, the lotto letters will multiply your score.How many words made up with 3 - 8 letters can you find before the time runs out?*Simple, fun game play. *The dictionary contains over 60,000 words. *Got a super high score? Then post it to Game Center.  *Game Center achievements are there to be won. NOTE: Eek there is a bug.... sometimes the first letter of the word may not show up. I'm getting a fix to you ASAP, until then pausing and un-pausing the game will fix it. Sorry about that.

games.name: LEGO Harry Potter Collection
games.summary: HD versionWould you like to play and learn Japanese at the same time? Are you interested in Japanese culture? If the answer is yes, definitely Fude Samurai is your game. Learn japanese or die trying. •Learn 103 Kanjis from JLPT Noken 5 •Study all vocabulary related to kanjis from JLPT Noken 5 •All kanjis and vocabulary with audio files, in order to hear the correct pronunciation •Multilanguage available ( English, Spanish, Brazilian, Chinese, Korean, German, Japanese, French and Italian ) •Fude samurai has 6 world plenty of enemies to fight. •Game compatible with iPodTouch, iPhone and iPad

games.name: Resident Evil 2: Deluxe Edition
games.summary:
An unprecedented biological disaster that strikes Raccoon City drags rookie police officer Leon S. Kennedy and Claire Redfield, a college student who has come to town to visit her brother, into a tragedy unlike any they’ve ever faced. 

Amid this extreme situation where the living dead devour humans, will the two of them manage to survive?

An immersive gaming experience switched to over-the-shoulder perspective, the terror of zombies brought to life by the latest technology, and a story with even greater depth. Featuring a wealth of existing downloadable content, the game is reborn.

games.name: Resident Evil 3
games.summary:
Fight your way to freedom from the brink of despair. A series of strange disappearances have been occurring in the American Midwest within a place called Racoon City. A specialist squad of the police force known as S.T.A.R.S. has been investigating the case, and have determined that the pharmaceutical company Umbrella and their biological weapon, the T-Virus, are behind the incidents though they've lost several members in the process. Jill Valentine and the other surviving S.T.A.R.S. members try to make this truth known, but find that the police department itself is under Umbrella's sway and their reports are rejected out of hand.

However, soon reports of a grisly "cannibal virus" begin to surface, and vicious dogs begin roaming the streets. With the viral plague spreading through the town and to her very doorstep, Jill is determined to survive.
However, unbeknownst to Jill, an extremely powerful pursuer has already been dispatched to eliminate her.

games.name: Resident Evil 4: Gold Edition
games.summary: Resident Evil 4: Gold Edition

games.name: Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer: Holiday Play Edition
games.summary:
Join in All the Reindeer Games - And Save Christmas!

Dash into the enchanting world of Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer and embark on a quest to save Christmas in this magical adventure inspired by the animated classic! Journey through Rudolph’s winter wonderlands as you help Rudolph and his friends overcome challenges, enjoy joyful exploration, and experience cooperative gameplay in a festive adventure for the whole family.

The Holiday Play Edition includes the King Moonracer’s Kingdom of Misfits DLC Expansion:

Help King Moonracer find his toy soldiers who are scattered across the all-new King Moonracer’s Castle region. Venture through 6 secret doors, complete challenges, and search for 24 new bells. Featuring Sam the Snowman as a new playable character.

DLC Includes:

• All new region featuring six levels, a new storyline, and challenges.
• Added playable character: Sam the Snowman.
• New game mechanic "Sliding Ice" for exciting platforming challenges.

games.name: Swarm Me
games.summary: A minimalist horde survival arena where you’re hunted by an endless swarm of drones - kite the horde, bait them into deadly traps, upgrade your defenses, use special items and survive as long as you can. Every minute the swarm grows denser, faster, and deadlier.

games.name: Tales of Eternia Remastered
games.summary: Tales of Eternia returns as a remastered edition! As the threat of world destruction looms, an epic journey begins to determine the fate of two worlds: Inferia and Celestia.

games.name: Tenebris Somnia
games.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a survival horror adventure game in the same vein as classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil - but adapted to a retro 2D aesthetic from the 8 or 16-bit era.

You will struggle to survive while solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures. 

Yet the secrets of the game lie within its cinematics...

When you reach certain key points you will see sequences from a completely different point of view, made in live action with real actors and practical effects - created by a professional and award winning film crew from Argentina.

games.name: DuneCrawl
games.summary:
DuneCrawl is an open world action-adventure game where you and up to three friends explore the sandy seas atop a gigantic Crab Crawler.

Battle against the jar-headed Vassals, survive hordes of wild bugs, explore oasis islands and delve devious dungeons all to help your fellow Polloi pilgrims win their war against the Ceramicist’s invasion!

games.name: Frostpunk
games.summary: In a completely frozen world, people develop steam-powered technology to oppose the overwhelming cold. Society in its current form becomes ineffective and it has to change in order to survive.

games.name: Shoresy: Legends of the North
games.summary: Shoresy: Legends of the North brings the hit TV comedy series Shoresy (Hulu, Crave, Netflix, SBS) to life with a modern take on classic hockey video games. Enjoy fast-paced Sudbury Blueberry Bulldog hockey gameplay with hits, goals, fights, chirps and more.

games.name: Classic Sonic Collection
games.summary:
Decades of classics and endless speed. Spin dash through iconic worlds, celebrate the legacy, and keep going in one epic collection of sonic adventures.

Sonic Mania
Experience classic 2D Sonic action with stunning retro inspired visuals, reimagined fan favorite zones, new bosses, and playable Sonic, tails and knuckles. Race, fly and smash your way through a nostalgic adventure with co op and competition modes.

Sonic Origins
Relive Sonic's most iconic adventures, including Sonic and the hedgehog, Sonic the Hedgehog 2, Sonic 3 and Knuckles, and Sonic CD, fully remastered in high definition. Revisit the games that launched a legend and shaped generations of Sonic fans.

Sonic Superstars
Race through classic sonic platforming reimagined with vibrant 3D visuals, new chaos emerald powers, and an all new adventure. Play as Sonic, Tails, Knuckles or Amy, team up with friends in 4 player co op, and take on Dr. Eggman and his allies across the Northstar Islands.

games.name: I Am Your Beast
games.summary:
I Am Your Beast is a shortform covert revenge thriller FPS about getting hunted across the North American wilderness by the military-industrial complex--and turning the tables.

You are secret agent Alphonse Harding. Retired for six years, you've been asked to complete ‘one last job’, one too many times. Declining your latest mission sets in motion a furious guerilla war between you and the Covert Operations Initiative (COI) that litters the forest with bodies and bullet casings.

Break your opponents. Use their own equipment against them. Duck into your tunnel network before enemy forces zero in on your location. Repeat.

games.name: Modern Sonic Collection
games.summary:
Three adventures and unlimited speed. Blast through alien amusement parks, rally a resistance, and explore uncharted frontiers in three epic Sonic adventures.

Sonic Forces
The evil Dr. Eggman has taken control of the world. Now you must defeat iconic old villains and fight a powerful new enemy to reclaim the world in this epic new adventure.

Sonic Colors Ultimate
Join Sonic on a high speed adventure to free the Wisps from Dr. Eggman's interstellar amusement park. Race through six vibrant worlds, harness powerful Wisp abilities, and overcome dangerous challenges.

Sonic Frontiers
In search of the missing chaos emeralds, Sonic becomes stranded on an ancient island teeming with unusual creatures. Battle hordes of powerful enemies as you explore a breathtaking world of action, adventure, and mystery.

games.name: We Were Here Tomorrow
games.summary:
You and your partner wake up inside mysterious pods. Strange machinery is buzzing around you, and the world beyond the glass is one you no longer recognize.

A calm, confident voice guides you through the unfamiliar facility, equipping you both with useful tools as you puzzle your way through a list of assignments together.

Left with many questions and few choices, you carry out the orders given to you.

Each assignment brings new asymmetrical puzzles that can only be solved through cooperation and trust. You will often find yourselves separated, relying solely on your walkie-talkies to communicate. It’s up to you to describe what you see, share what you know, and piece together the truth as one.

With every puzzle you solve, you’ll come closer to understanding why you and your partner are here and what your role is in the facility. Only together you can decide what Tomorrow will hold.

games.name: SNO: Ultimate Freeriding
games.summary: SNØ is a minimalistic freeriding game. Push your limits for the high score, or simply explore the endless wilderness.

games.name: Stupid Never Dies
games.summary:
Set in a monster-ruled otherworldly dungeon, Stupid Never Dies puts you in control of Davy, a timid zombie living at the very bottom of monster society. Defeat enemies, level up, and collect strange items to grow stronger on your quest to bring Julia, a frozen human girl, back to life.

Steal enemy abilities, customize your undead body with bizarre upgrades, and experience fast-paced combat packed with innovation.

Developed by GPTRACK50, a new studio formed by veteran action game developers, Stupid Never Dies delivers a single-player 3D action RPG experience unlike anything you’ve played before.

games.name: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced
games.summary: The Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced is a collection of three traditional 2D action platformers, “Azure Striker Gunvolt” (2014), “Azure Striker Gunvolt 2” (2016), and “Azure Striker Gunvolt 3” (2022) together in one release, complete with all DLC.

games.name: Back to the Dawn
games.summary: In Back to the Dawn, you play a reporter caught up in a dark conspiracy and who got thrown into a maximum-security prison for not playing ball. Gather your wits and learn how to survive in this hostile environment. Explore every inch of the prison and exploit any weakness you find. Make friends (or foes) with your fellow inmates and with their help, break out of prison. It's not just your life you are saving, but the entire city!

games.name: Beyond the Dark: Nightwatch
games.summary:
Beyond the Dark: Nightwatch is a two-player shared horror experience built around asymmetrical collaboration.

In Beyond the Dark: Nightwatch, communication is the only thing standing between survival and darkness. One player wakes up alone inside a strange, deeply unsettling house haunted by something lurking in the shadows. Escaping will not be easy, but this is not a solo experience: a second player must guide, interpret, and coordinate the first player’s actions from a different perspective.

Separated by perspective but bound by a shared objective, both players must talk, strategize, and react in real time to the horrors around them. 

The cooperative horror experience Beyond the Dark: Nightwatch turns communication into both your greatest strength and your biggest risk. Clear instructions can save you. Misunderstandings can doom you.

games.name: Cotton Reboot!
games.summary:
Japan's favorite shooter mascot finally gets a worldwide release as a beautiful HD game with stunning graphics and remixed soundtracks. 

This is the original "Cute em' up", and will test your skills as well as tug on the heartstrings as Cotton and her friends are finally back in the ultimate celebration of one of Japan's most beloved gaming mascots. Choose between the HD Reboot mode or go legit with the X68000 original mode with pixel perfect graphics from the iconic Japanese home computer.

games.name: Cotton Reboot! High Tension!
games.summary:
The sequel to "Cotton Reboot!" released in 2021 is here! Will the gluttonous witch Nata de Cotton be in action again this time?

Enjoy this even more powerful and refreshing witchy shooter!

games.name: Demons' Night Fever
games.summary:
Based on classic grid-based strategy games, this entirely new SRPG features the Peon Exploitation System - a brutal combat mechanic where you mercilessly sacrifice your own allies.

The more misdeeds you commit, the more vicious your army becomes, and the greater your advantage in battle!

Regain the lost power of the Devil, Giga Super Death, who was transformed into a baby, and crush the false god wearing a mask of justice!

games.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.summary: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

games.name: Gaelco Sports Collection
games.summary:
Get ready for the ultimate 90s arcade rush. This collection brings back 5 legendary, lightning-fast hits developed by the arcade masters at Gaelco. Forget complex simulations; here, it’s all about raw reflexes, immediate fun, and high-speed challenges that defined a generation of cabinet gaming.

Drive at breakneck speeds in the cult-classic isometric racers World Rally Championship and World Rally 2, where every corner requires perfect drifts against a brutal 60-second timer.

Conquer treacherous slopes in Snowboard Championship, execute precise racket strikes in Squash, and dominate the sand with fierce smashes in Touch and Go.

It’s a pure dopamine rush straight from the golden age of arcades.

games.name: Moadra
games.summary: Endure... Evolve... or die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

games.name: My Friendly Neighborhood
games.summary:
Something is amiss with everyone's favorite Saturday morning puppet show! For years, the colorful cast of The Friendly Neighborhood delighted audiences across the globe with their cooky capers and educational adventures. However, as time went on and interest waned, the production studio found themselves out of money and closed their doors for good.

Toy sales would dwindle, and birthday balloons and cakes would find new mascots. In time, the once household names would fade into increasingly niche fandoms. Until one night years later, the studio unexpectedly clicks back to life and starts broadcasting The Friendly Neighborhood. TV sets across the globe flicker for a moment before the familiar puppets return for a surprise encore!

Play as Gordon, a repairman sent to get to the bottom of this disturbing dilemma. Fend off puppets and solve puzzles in this survival horror adventure.

games.name: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort
games.summary:
Get up and move in 12 motion-control sports!

Gently swing your racket, pull back and aim like an archer, and more in 12 sports with intuitive motion controls.

Move together in sports like Bowling and Basketball, duke it out in Boxing, and even battle with one thumb in Thumb Wrestling—there are lots of ways to compete and have fun together!

Explore the island getaway using Joy-Con™ 2 mouse controls in Skateboarding, steer across the waves in Power Cruising, and tilt the controller to fly around freely in Prop Plane.

Create and customize your Sportsmate or Mii™ characters, and jump into the fun online* or offline** in Nintendo Switch™ Sports Resort!

games.name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
games.summary:
Pre-order any digital edition and receive:

- Early access to the Open Beta*
- Hunter Killer Operator Skin** - Immediately unlock the Hunter Killer Operator Skin in Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7 and Call of Duty®: Warzone™.

War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches a full-scale invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4.

A young squad of South Korean soldiers fight to survive on the collapsing front lines, while half a world away a vengeful Captain Price wages a personal war from the shadows as he stays one step ahead of those hunting him. As Price’s off-book mission collides with the forces behind the invasion, the war spreads beyond anyone’s control.

Modern Warfare® 4 pushes the series into darker and more dangerous territory, where consequence and escalation bring long-running storylines to a powerful and emotional breaking point.

- Campaign drops players into trench warfare in Korea, close-quarters combat in New York, high-octane chases through Paris, SAS night raids in Mumbai, and city-wide assaults to reclaim occupied territory.
- Multiplayer delivers grounded, precise combat where fluid movement, player choice, and greater control define every engagement.
- In DMZ, players operate as an off-the-books asset behind enemy lines, where every extraction run into contested territory forces hard choices about which objectives to pursue, what to secure, and when to get out.


Available on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox on PC, not available on Xbox One.

TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot required for PC, other security measures may be enforced. Learn more at https://support.activision.com/tpm.

Requires an Activision account and acceptance of the Activision Software License and Services Agreement. A mobile phone number linked to your Activision account may be required to play Modern Warfare® 4.

Additional storage space may be required for mandatory game updates.
