games.name: ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet
games.summary: Hop aboard a delectable management sim in the world of ONE PIECE! Work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to build the greatest floating restaurant of the seas. Collect ingredients, dream up dishes, and decorate to have familiar faces lining up for more!

games.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
games.summary: Create your own Warrior Cat and journey through the Lake Territories in an immersive action-adventure inspired by the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Hunt, explore, battle rival Clans, uncover prophecies, and shape your legacy with every choice you make.

games.name: Fangtopia
games.summary: Sink your fangs into Fangtopia, a cozy and relaxing tile puzzle game where you assemble landscapes to craft a monsterrific paradise for friendly ghouls and ghosts. Design a care-free, scare-free world of gentle chills.

games.name: Hunter's Moon
games.summary: Help Dirk, Lindsey and Miguel surf the train and collect the valuable gems. Leap from wagon to wagon gathering gems as you go, but watch out for other objects that have been discarded on top of the train. Hit them and you'll fall from the train.? Run as far as you can before you get knocked off the train? Multiple characters to unlock, including Miguel the skateboarding champ.? Beat your and other players high score? Universal game for iPhone and iPadHave you got what it takes to Surf the Train?

games.name: 9 R.I.P. sequel
games.summary:
The previous work, "9 RIP," weaves the story of a bizarre love and the supernatural encounters in the afterlife. In this "9 RIP sequel," you can enjoy the continuation of the story.

The work begins with the two endings from the previous work. The main content, "Heaven Edition," which takes place after "Final Act: Heaven," is a sequel that depicts a new horror.

The sub-content, "God Edition," which takes place after "Final Act: God," is a fan disc that leads to a sweet and happy ending.

Please look forward to the various strange worlds and the fate of the strange characters and the love that is woven once again.

games.name: Bloom Busters
games.summary:
Bloom Busters is a casual game that tells the story of Jimmy and Jessie, two gardeners who live in magical village called Bloomland. The game centers around the player's ability to help Jimmy and Jessie rescue Bloomland's farms and forests from the invasion of squishy creatures roaming the land. 

Bloom Busters blends the best in fast pace action-arcade puzzles with a build-your-garden-style theme. The game offers many hours of extraordinary and challenging obstacles for all ages and combines a unique blend of story and humor.

games.name: Dog Man: Bark in Action
games.summary:
Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure! A comic-book style game packed with action, humor, boss fights, and ability-granting gadgets. Play as 10 different characters from the comics, each with unique powers.

A hero is needed! Dr. Scum has set up Hypno Screens around the city, mind-controlling the innocent townsfolk. Now it’s up to Dog Man - part Dog, part Man- to fight back against Dr. Scum and all his minions. Defeat Dr. Scum, save your friends, and rescue the city!

games.name: Farming Simulator 25: Beans & Alpacas Edition
games.summary:
Build your coffee estate and grow a warmer kind of farm life in the Beans & Alpacas Expansion: Travel to Catuaí, a South America-inspired region where coffee plantations cover rolling hills, red soil shapes the land and dense greenery stretches across lower mountain slopes. New crops, animals, production chains and more than 25 new machines await.

Catuaí: Welcome to South America!

Explore a lush, humid valley with narrow roads, dusty streets, scattered rocks and a winding river running through the landscape. A small rural town with colorful buildings, shops and agricultural depots connects the region, while stilt houses line the river shore.

Coffee, Animals & New Gameplay

Cultivate coffee beans as a new crop and expand your livestock with alpacas and Brahman cows. Alpacas add new hands-on interaction through shearing and leading, while wild animals like crocodiles and parrots bring more life to the environment.

Productions, Projects & Collectibles

Create new products such as pigment and resin, and repaint houses for the community, or start production chains for crop processing. Take on the Research Center construction project, find dinosaur skeleton parts and collect your discoveries in the collectible museum.

Machines, Brands & Details

Operate 25+ new machines from Case IH, Ford, John Deere, KUHN, Mercedes-Benz Trucks, New Holland, Valtra, and many more. Colombo Industries joins the series as a new brand, while enhanced ground tool animations and improved effects increase immersion.

games.name: Minecraft
games.summary: The game involves players creating and destroying various types of blocks in a three dimensional environment. The player takes an avatar that can destroy or create blocks, forming fantastic structures, creations and artwork across the various multiplayer servers in multiple game modes.

games.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
games.summary:
Thirteen months after six young girls vanished in Sicily, a new clue reopens the nightmare. 

When a mysterious recording rekindles the hope that her daughter might still be alive, Susan, against all reason, decides to go to the place where everything seems to have begun: a decaying noble residence isolated on the slopes of Mount Etna and once owned by the Ashmann family.

What starts as a desperate search soon becomes a journey into terror, where family secrets, memory, and obsession intertwine. Susan finds herself drawn into a labyrinth of relentless stalkers, hidden symbols, and supernatural phenomena. As reality fractures and dark powers rise, every step brings her closer to the truth… and to a terror older than herself.

Created to captivate both newcomers and longtime fans of the Remothered saga, Red Nun’s Legacy blends classic survival horror, stealth, and psychological horror, introducing new mechanics centered on perception, hypnosis, and environmental manipulation.

games.name: The Seance of Blake Manor
games.summary: The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery, set in 1897 Ireland, where you investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane in a remote hotel full of secrets and other-worldly occurrences.

games.name: Village in the Shade
games.summary:
From the development team behind the Yomawari series, Hono Gurashi no Niwa is a life simulation game set in a nostalgic rural village.

Farm and take care of livestock, enjoy activities like fishing and hunting, and deepen your relationships with the other villagers…

Your nostalgic and heartwarming rural life begins.

games.name: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game
games.summary:
Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game is a fast-paced 1v1 fighter where you battle as your favorite characters from the Avatar franchise. Featuring hand-drawn 2D animation true to the series’ roots, proprietary rollback netcode, and full cross-play for smooth, competitive gameplay.

Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game is a fighter rooted in the spirit of elemental mastery. Designed for both newcomers and veterans, it channels the energy of classic fighting games while breaking new ground in movement, style, and combat expression. Built with a focus on fluidity, responsiveness, and online integrity, the game invites players to discover what it truly means to fight with purpose.

Hand-drawn in 2D, it is crafted to preserve the style and expressive animation of the original series.

games.name: Fallen City Brawl
games.summary:
As a brutal battle for control of Fallen City's criminal underworld rages, four strangers join forces to survive and reclaim the streets! With a ferocious wolf at their sides, these unlikely allies will face impossible odds. Along the way, motivations and past lives will collide, further testing their loyalty as well as their fighting skills. Only by binding together can they reach the final showdown that will decide who lives and who falls.

Inspired by arcade beat 'em ups of the late '80s and early '90s, Fallen City Brawl is a story of ambition and revenge told through intense side-scrolling pixel art action.

games.name: Gennady
games.summary: Gennady is a dynamic roguelike platformer, where you must fight your way through shifting corridors filled with chthonic creatures, and death only makes you stronger. All wrapped in the legendary absurdity and classic animation inspired by the era of Earthworm Jim.

games.name: Rogue Reigns
games.summary: Rogue Reigns is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder about trust and sacrifice. Lead selfish antiheroes through a world where death is no more, and something still hunts them. Build synergies that bind them or rivalries that break them. Nobody dies, some are sacrificed, but everybody is condemned.

games.name: ANOMALITH
games.summary:
Remain yourself. Live on.

Anomalies × Mutating Girl × Survival TPS

Survive a world crawling with Anomalies.
The girl faces her fate, gun in hand—

ーーーーー
■ STORY
ーーーーー
Japan, the year 20██.
Anomaly Zones suddenly appear without any sign.
In search of her friend who went missing in an Anomaly Zone, 17 year old Reona Minazuki becomes a Diver for the government-backed Anomaly Zone Countermeasures Office.

On her first Dive, as countless other Divers fall victim to the Zone, a strange power awakens within her.

The sole survivor, she heads deep into the abyss of Anomaly Zones.

Her friend's disappearance, the origin of Anomaly Zones, and the mystery of her powers—
When all of it is finally revealed, what will she see—?

games.name: Choice of Life: Floors
games.summary:
Choice of Life: Floors is a psychological horror detective game where every choice shapes your story. An elevator descends through the endless floors of your own home, leading you into a game against your own mind. Each step brings you closer to escape... or to madness

Use the items you find, fight the creatures of your mind, embrace the absurdity of your situation, and decide: will you escape this nightmare, or drown in it forever?

A dark story told with irony and humor, heightening both the absurdity of the events and the fragility of the human mind. Sometimes, laughing at horror is the only way to cope.

games.name: Choice of Life: Samosbor
games.summary:
The legendary Choice of Life franchise returns in a new game!

The gray concrete walls of the living cell, closing the hermetic door at the sound of a siren - all this is commonplace in Gigastructure. Everything here goes its way, until the block is isolated in search of a secret object...

games.name: Croc 2 Kingdom of the Gobbos
games.summary: Croc's back, and this time he's searching for his long-lost parents. Revived by the Dantinis, arch enemy Baron Dante vows revenge. Explore four mainland villages, rescue Gobbos, and battle new Guardians. Race cars and speedboats, ride minecarts, and take to the skies in the remastered 1999 classic.

games.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles 2
games.summary:
The Digital Standard Edition features the following:

    Base game
    Two Kimetsu Academy Character Unlock Keys – Kyojuro Rengoku and Tengen Uzui
    Pre-order bonus: 2 Character Unlock Keys** – Muichiro Tokito and Mitsuri Kanroji

games.name: Hello Kitty Party Land
games.summary: Join the party at Party Land and team up with beloved Sanrio characters to play together in a variety of exciting mini games. Meet over 145 beloved characters and collect their stickers! Team up with one of 16 playable Sanrio characters and play as your own avatar or your favorite teammate. Jump into 45+ mini games with friends, either offline or online. Try Board Game mode, and keep the fun going with quick mini games while you wait for your turn.  Create a character that’s uniquely yours! Customize everything from hairstyles to outfits, and unlock even more items as you progress through the game.

games.name: Hunting Simulator 3
games.summary:
This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog or fellow hunters by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.

Either on foot or behind the wheel of your all-terrain vehicle, explore this open world's stunning environments.

In these ever-changing ecosystems, each animal reacts to what you do, each individual ages over time, can reproduce and exhibits true-to-life behaviour thanks to our unique “SimFauna” system.

Kit yourself out with one of the official weapons and other items, to hunt the way you want.

games.name: Joe & Mac Retro Collection
games.summary:
Developed by Red Art Studios, Red Art Games' internal development studio, the Joe & Mac Retro Collection is a compilation of Joe & Mac: Caveman Ninja, Congo's Caper, and Joe & Mac 2: Lost in the Tropics, the three Joe & Mac titles developed by Data East and released on Super Nintendo between 1991 and 1995. 

In addition to allowing players to rediscover the original games as they were presented back in the 90s, the Joe & Mac Retro Collection also features numerous quality of life improvements!

games.name: Metro Redux
games.summary:
Last bullet. Last breath. Last chance. Experience two of the finest story-driven shooters of all time.

Remastered for PS4

Enter the depths of the Moscow Metro network with the definitive versions of both Metro 2033 and Metro: Last Light - rebuilt for PlayStation 4.

Take on the challenge of Ranger Mode - offering an extra layer of difficulty and immersion. Enjoy hours of extra content as Metro Redux includes every add-on released for both Metro 2033 and Metro: Last Light.

games.name: Pardon My French Toast
games.summary: Pardon My French Toast is a 3D platformer starring a slice of toast who covers himself in sweet spreads to get fun abilities.

games.name: Phantom Blade Zero
games.summary: S-GAME presents Phantom Blade Zero, a fusion of classic Wuxia storytelling and exhilarating action powered by Unreal Engine 5. You play as Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live. Fend off assassins, unravel world-ending conspiracies, and defend your values with your life.

games.name: Planted!
games.summary:
Planted! is a co-op party game that pits 1-4 players into head-to-head, horticultural combat that will require you to Sow, Grow and Throw your way to victory.  

Part harvest sim, part sports game, and 100% cultivated chaos, Planted! challenges players to take on their friends in arena combat where they will need to strategically plan their produce production for success. Will they utilise fertiliser to grow colossal crops for more points, will they steal their opponents offerings, or will they use powerups to propel themselves to victory? Only thyme will tell. 

Jump in to multiplayer (Online or offline!) chaos with friends all whilst reeking havoc across 8 diverse biomes. Multiplayer not for you? Then put your green thumbs to the test and take on the hand crafted single-player story campaign and enter the world of competitive gardening! Who knew there were so many ways to garden?!?

games.name: Pokemon Legends: Z-A Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Mega Dimension
games.summary:
Purchase the physical version of the Pokémon™ Legends: Z-A – Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Mega Dimension bundle and you will get an insert containing a code for 100 Ultra Balls as a purchase bonus. You can receive them by choosing Get via Internet in the Mystery Gift* function of your game. 

Live the life of a Pokémon Trainer and help protect the peace in Lumiose City—enhanced for the Nintendo Switch 2 system!

Lumiose City—a home for people and Pokémon alike. Thanks to an urban redevelopment plan driven by Quasartico Inc., the lush greenery of verdant parks intermingles with facilities using the latest cutting-edge technology. A lot has changed here since the days of the Pokémon™ X and Pokémon Y games!

Choose Chikorita, Tepig, or Totodile as your first partner Pokémon, and then set off on a grand adventure! Your journey will take you to all manner of sights in the streets arrayed around Prism Tower, including shops, restaurants, and places called wild zones—where Pokémon roam free. As you catch, train, and battle Pokémon, there will be plenty of people to meet too—like AZ, the enigmatic owner of Hotel Z, and Team MZ, the crew that aims to keep Lumiose a peaceful place.

And with performance upgrades for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system, you’ll experience Lumiose City like never before: with enhanced resolution and frame rates!

games.name: Souls of Bombarika
games.summary: A lone ghost battles deadly Ghost Bosses threatening humanity. Possess objects, solve reality-bending puzzles, and uncover an emotional mother-son story.

games.name: STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT
games.summary:
Scenarios with Improved Readability
Based on the scenario from STEINS;GATE ELITE, the story has been refined to be more evenly paced, with an overall smoother reading experience. Along with new dialogue and narrative text, a brand-new worldline and ending scenario have been added, bringing players a story never before seen. The game features a substantially expanded volume of text, delivering a richer story experience.

Newly Recorded Voices and Sound
All in-game voice lines have been newly recorded in Japanese, while the entire soundtrack has been remade by Composer Tsuyoshi Abo.

Revamped Graphics
All character art, backgrounds, and event still images have been completely redrawn from scratch, resulting in a major visual revamp. Compared to the original Xbox 360 version, the number of event still images has approximately doubled, while the number of background visuals has increased by roughly 20%. The expanded volume of artwork delivers an even more immersive experience.

games.name: The Last Cat in the Universe
games.summary: Gather the remains of a dying space station to build a cozy home for the last cat in the universe. A short, narrative-driven incremental game about finding peace in the face of darkness

games.name: The Transference
games.summary: Jump into an escape room set in a deranged mind and experience a first-person exploration game in a chilling new dimension. Shift between three perspectives and attempt to unravel the mystery hiding in this mind-bending psychological thriller. Project yourself into a riveting narrative experience and become immersed in an unsettling psychological thriller. Piece together a family's mystery as you recover fragmented memories from the corrupted consciousness of each perspective. In this first-person narrative mystery, you must explore the walls of the family's home to interpret events and discover the truth. Playable in VR and non-VR modes.

games.name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
games.summary:
Step back into Fabletown in The Wolf Among Us Remastered - the definitive edition of Telltale’s acclaimed noir narrative thriller inspired by DC’s award-winning Fables comic series.

Critically acclaimed, The Wolf Among Us became one of the most celebrated story-driven adventures of its generation, praised for its unforgettable characters, sharp writing, and meaningful player choice.

Fully remastered with enhanced visuals and modern presentation, this definitive edition brings Bigby Wolf’s first investigation to life with greater atmosphere, immersion, and detail than ever before - honoring the original experience while introducing Fabletown to a new generation of players.

Investigate brutal murders, interrogate suspects, explore crime scenes, and uncover a conspiracy hiding beneath the streets of Fabletown, where myths and legends live secretly among us.

games.name: The Zibbo Show
games.summary: The treasures of the pirates were buried somewhere in the deep ocean, let's star sailing and find them out!You'll encounter many puzzles in your journey, figure them out and go through, you can do it!This is a popular and relaxing game that will bring you endless fun!

games.name: Asylum
games.summary: Use waves of monsters to overcome the tower defence and escape the asylum.

games.name: Blasphemous: Martyrs' Edition
games.summary: The Martyr’s Limited Edition includes the complete Blasphemous game with all expansions, along with a visual compendium featuring iconic artwork, a printed manual, an exclusive art print, a personal letter from the development team, and a digital code to download the full soundtrack.

games.name: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares
games.summary: Jump, glide, and outsmart traps in this spooky 3D platformer! Smash obstacles, solve puzzles, and fend off evil spirits to defeat The Dream Master. Collect hidden treasures and restore joy to a world shrouded in darkness!

games.name: Goodboy Galaxy
games.summary:
With his home world on the brink of ecological collapse, Maxwell bravely hopped into his experimental ship in dogged pursuit of a solution.

Beyond the point of no return, holding out forlorn hope, he finds himself stranded - thousands of lightyears from home, at the edge of a hostile galaxy.

Help Maxwell explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces.

Goodboy Galaxy is a game in development for Game Boy Advance, PC and Nintendo Switch. It's an exploration focused platform game similar to Metroid or Cave Story.

games.name: Nightmare: The Lunatic
games.summary: Nightmare: The Lunatic is a hardcore action roguelite platformer game where you escape your nightmare. Swap between 3 weapons constantly, use special attacks, and dodge and parry enemies' attacks. Strengthen yourself by collecting powerful and distinctive totems.

games.name: Pinballoid Crush
games.summary: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.

games.name: Queen's Domain
games.summary:
Queen’s Domain is a retro-fantasy action RPG. Washed up on the shores of the Isle of Neasied, you set out to find your father and uncover the dark heart of this mysterious isle. 

Wield the Legendary Holy Sword Endu to take flight from platform to platform, and discover an interconnected, labyrinthine world where secrets and dangers lurk around every corner. 

Fight action-oriented battles with a classic stamina meter, powerful charge attacks, weapon specific special attacks, and secondary throwing weapons. Level up, accessorize, and choose from a huge catalogue of melee weapons on your quest to fight your way through the hordes of monsters and powerful bosses awaiting you in the darkest depths of the isle. 

Features:

Explore an interconnected island filled with hidden secrets

Lovingly crafted retro-fantasy aesthetic 

Action-combat with a stamina meter, special attacks, throwing weapons & more

Fly across gaps with your Holy Sword – use upgrades to fly further!

Dozens of hours of adventuring and exploration

50+ melee weapons to discover, equip, and upgrade

Use XP to level up, and eat delicious food to further increase your stats

20+ types of secondary throwing weapons allow for varied strategies in combat

Over 100 enemies, mini bosses, and bosses to defeat

games.name: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
games.summary: The Cat in the Hat once said, “It is fun to have fun, but you have to know how.” Everyone from the mischievous Dr. Seuss classic is here. Become smart and steady Sally, energetic wild card Johnny, cause double the trouble as Thing 1 and Thing 2 or be cheerful Little Cat A. And of course, the chaos conductor, The Cat in the Hat and anxiously wise Fish will be there to help, on this zany ride. Play solo or go against your friends, choosing from two trick-filled game modes. Fancy a game of chase? Then “Find the Cat” will have you turning the house upside down looking for The Cat in the Hat. Or maybe you prefer getting into chaotic challenges? See how quickly you can capture penguins, decorate a cake, and who knows what else in the 18 minigames you can choose from. But the fun doesn’t stop there, just like The Cat’s hat, it’ll be full of tricks. With varying difficulty levels, long challenges and short, there’s something for everyone. Get ready for your house to be filled with giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.

games.name: ANTONBLAST
games.summary:
ANTONBLAST is a fast-paced explosive action platformer that's all about destruction. Play as the enraged Dynamite Anton (or his cranked-out coworker Annie) and use your Mighty F’n Hammer to demolish bizarre worlds, tussle with screen-filling bosses, and steal your Spirits back from Satan!

That's right: Satan himself has stolen Anton's prized Spirit collection, and he'll stop at nothing to get it back. Thankfully, the local disgraced casino owner, Brulo, has his own beef with Satan, and he's willing to put aside his differences with Anton to make that devil pay.

Your mission in every level is simple: SET Brulo's Detonators, FIND Anton's Spirit, and ESCAPE before Happy Hour ends!

games.name: BloodRayne: Definitive Collection
games.summary:
The BloodRayne: Definitive Edition unites all three iconic entries in the series in one complete, enhanced collection, bringing the legendary dhampir back with updated visuals and modern improvements.

Become Rayne, a half-human, half-vampire agent working for the Brimstone Society, as she hunts supernatural threats across a dark and violent world. From battling occult forces tied to the Third Reich to confronting her own vampiric bloodline, Rayne’s journey spans brutal conflicts, relentless enemies, and deeply personal vendettas.

This collection includes the original BloodRayne, BloodRayne 2, and BloodRayne: Betrayal - Fresh Bites, combining fast-paced third-person action with stylish 2D hack-and-slash gameplay. Face hordes of soldiers, grotesque creatures, and powerful bosses using Rayne’s acrobatic combat skills, brutal melee attacks, and vampiric abilities.

games.name: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 1 / 2 / 3
games.summary:
Introducing the Trilogy Box, a set of three packaged versions of the "Senjou no Fuga" series and luxurious goods!

The long-awaited package version of the trilogy of the dramatic simulation RPG "Fuga of the Battlefield" series with the themes of war, revenge, and beasts is now available!

The Nintendo Switch package, Taranis Metal Figure, art book, and soundtrack will be delivered in a special box.

games.name: James Pond Legacy: The Pond is Not Enough
games.summary:
The James Pond series of games is one of the most beloved and successful franchises from the 80’s & 90’s. Known for its innovative gameplay, memorable graphics, atmospheric music and blockbusting reviews, the series captivated gamers the world over and set a new standard for platform games.

This collection brings together the entire James Pond series of C64 versions along with Amiga 500, Sega Megadrive/Genesis and SNES, where available, for the first time... James Pond: Underwater Agent, James Pond: Codename RoboCod, James Pond 3: Operation StarFish and James Pond: Aquatic Games!

games.name: Neverway
games.summary:
After Fiona quits her job, she starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. 

Keep your life from falling apart while searching for Neverway, a nightmare reality that is slowly leaking into yours.

Neverway features a top-down, fast-paced combat with an emphasis on player expression. Craft items to customize your playstyle, and unlock combat abilities through your friendship bonds.

Farm and craft items, prepare meals, or just decorate your homestead. Time progresses in three blocks, and you choose when to advance: morning, afternoon, and evening. One day at a time.

games.name: Treachery in Beatdown City: Ultra Remix
games.summary: Treachery in Beatdown City: ULTRA REMIX is a massive story and content update for Treachery in Beatdown City! Tripling the content, Ultra Remix adds new levels, lots of new exciting attacks, defense options, ~80 more enemies to fight, new music, and more!

games.name: Ghost of Yotei: Echoes of Sekigahara
games.summary: Ghost of Yōtei: Echoes of Sekigahara is a new narrative expansion. Split between the present day and flashbacks to Atsu’s time on the mainland, you’ll meet Nagato, a figure from Atsu’s past who has arrived in Ezo. In the present, you’ll explore a previously unseen valley once inhabited by The Snake and his gang of loyal followers, the Vipers. In the past, you’ll experience Atsu’s time in the Battle of Sekigahara and a key moment in her life before she returned home for her quest for vengeance. You’ll meet new enemies and find new heavy weapons, new armor sets, new dyes, and more. [PlayStation]

games.name: Edge of Memories
games.summary:
The Corrosion, a plague of unparalleled proportions, has already ravaged the Astryan continent. On the other side of the world, the continent of Avaris and its nomadic peoples - so far spared from the horrors spawned by this abomination - now stand on the brink of extinction. Eline, an itinerant Soul Whisperer, relentlessly battles the force that turns the once-thriving fauna, flora and humans of this lush land into grotesque abominations. Following a mysterious encounter, a dark power awakens within her, one that may hold the key to ending this apocalypse: the ability to control the Corrosion within her own body.

But saving a world already doomed is no easy task. With the help of Ysoris, her unlikely mentor, and Kanta, shaman prince of a lost tribe, Eline must overcome the formidable adversaries standing in her way.

games.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
games.summary:
The ultimate kaiju arena brawler is back, completely remastered. From Atari and original developer, Pipeworks, Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered updates the 2002 fighter with enhanced visuals and quality of life improvements. 

Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through 8 locations, each with day and night variations. Battle through real-world cities, Monster Island, and the alien Mothership. Face off against your friends in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

Master your skills in cinematic kaiju vs. kaiju battles through familiar cities. Every monster has a distinctive moveset that makes each brawl unique, from vicious melee attacks to ranged energy blasts to special Rage Mode strikes. Tired of throwing punches? Why not throw a skyscraper, instead? The arenas are not just passive locations, and instead allow you to use the environment strategically in combat and even weaponize buildings and other landmarks.

games.name: Let's Sing 2027
games.summary:
Grab the mic - or your smartphone - and get ready to shine! The karaoke game Let's Sing 2027 transforms any occasion into a musical celebration with a brand-new playlist of chart-toppers and classics. Sing solo for high scores or team up with friends and family for unforgettable parties and performances.

Featuring songs with their original music videos, adjustable vocal guide settings, and easy-to-use smartphone and mic support, Let's Sing 2027 makes singing accessible, fun, and endlessly replayable. 

Whether you're hosting a party or chasing your best score, it's your turn to take center stage with the ultimate karaoke game!

games.name: Let's Sing ABBA
games.summary: Celebrate the glorious comeback of the Swedish pop giant ABBA. Party solo or with your friends to some of your favourite classics from the band's repertoire! Choose from a collection of 31 ABBA classics and perform them in seven different game modes. After a 40-year break, ABBA is back! So why not perform some of the band's biggest hits in your own living room to celebrate their triumphant return to the stage. Travel back to the glory days with hits like “Gimme! Gimme! Gimme!” and “Waterloo”. Get some friends together to party with “Dancing Queen”, the musical number “Mamma Mia” or rock out to “I Still Have Faith In You”, the lead track from their brand new album.

games.name: The Slormancer
games.summary:
The Slormancer is an epic 2D Action-RPG Dungeon Crawling game following a band of outcasts on their fight against hordes of enemies led by The Slormancer! Play as a "Mighty" Knight, a "Fierce" Huntress or a "Mischievous" Mage, master hundreds of abilities and ancestral powers, gear up, fight for the reputation of your kind and prove your value to the realm.

Featuring loads of shiny Loot, tons of collectibles, countless hours of content, a frenetic gameplay and carefully crafted pixel art.

games.name: Tom Clancy's The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park
games.summary:
This single-player or online co-op experience includes:
- A level 40 boost that allows you to jump right into the Echoes of Central Park campaign
- 50 stash space increase, allowing you to store more gear

EXPLORE CENTRAL PARK FOR THE FIRST TIME
Overgrown and reclaimed by nature, Central Park and the surrounding streets of Upper West Side are presented like never before. Haunted by fear and sinister tales, the park has become home to a new apex threat that lurks in its shadows. You must confront this formidable force, as well as familiar foes with their own agendas, to uncover what happened inside the park.

FIGHT ALONGSIDE UNIQUE COMPANIONS
As the Division’s mission is halted by a sinister threat, you must rely on three reluctant heroes to guide you through the park. Each brings a distinct past and fighting style, ranging from a former Division agent to a battle-hardened athlete.

UNLOCK A NEW ENDGAME EXPERIENCE
Ambushed and pressured by unknown ravagers, you first enter the park fighting to survive. Once the story is complete, the balance of power shifts, allowing you to return to Central Park and dictate the fight, pursue enemies on your own terms, and tackle new challenges to earn exclusive and valuable rewards.

EXPAND YOUR SKILLS AND GEAR
By defeating Central Park’s primary threats and their twisted abilities, you can earn new powers of your own. Six new skill variants grant beast‑like skills inspired by the horrors you’ll overcome. New gear is also introduced, including a brand-new Exotic Weapon, a new gear set, and more.

games.name: ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies
games.summary:
Brilliant, burnt-out, possibly cursed – you play as operant Hershel Wilk, alias CASCADE. Five years ago you led your team into the abyss and have been haunted by your failures ever since. Now you've been recalled for a mysterious assignment that may give you a chance to prove yourself again.

Find yourself thrown into a three-way struggle for cultural and ideological power, played out across an unforgettable new city. In ZERO PARADES, the world itself is a character with its own secrets, traumas, and miracles for you to discover.

To get anywhere in this world, you'll need friends. Unfortunately, you don't have any. Instead, you'll go up against international bankers, foreign techno-fascists, psychic doppelgängers, a paranoid TV presenter, a man with a box for a heart, and dozens more. Everyone you meet has their own agendas, beliefs, and secrets for you to uncover and turn to your own ends.

games.name: Lightyear Frontier
games.summary:
Lightyear Frontier is an open-world farming exploration game with crafting, resource management and base building, wrapped in a mystery-driven narrative with a cosmic country soundtrack.

Play 1-4 players in online co-op, discover and grow alien plants, domesticate wildlife, endure the elements and build your new home away from home.

games.name: VOID/BREAKER
games.summary:
You are trapped in an endless sequence by the all-seeing, hostile AI. You are its prisoner - forced to fight, die, and repeat.

The machines think you'll never escape. The system is designed to keep you here.

Adrenaline-Fueled Roguelite FPS. Fight relentless machines driven by a hostile AI. Escape an endless cycle. Craft infinite weapon variants with deep gun modding. Forge deadly synergies. Carve your way out through enviro destruction 

/BREAK THE SYSTEM /BREAK THE SEQUENCE /BREAK FREE

games.name: Chivalware
games.summary: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

games.name: CRYMELIGHT
games.summary: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

games.name: K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine
games.summary: In K-POP Rising: Dream to Shine, players immerse themselves in the demanding and fascinating world of modern music. Accompanied by their best friend Nova, they will need to commit 100 percent to the race for stardom: from intensive training sessions in the studio to the ultimate recognition on the most prestigious stages, the title offers a complete experience combining a sense of rhythm, deep customization, and community management in the era of social media.

games.name: Kingdom of Night
games.summary:
One night, in 1987, in the small town of Miami, Arizona, a satanic cult unwittingly summons the ancient evil, Baphomet, catapulting the town into chaos. John, awoken by the kidnapping of his neighbor, sets out into the night to fight back against the demonic invasion and rescue his friends before it's too late...

Take control of John as his adventure leads him through an hour-by-hour experience of what could be everyone's last night on Earth. As John, you will encounter unearthly evils, Demon lords, afflicted townsfolk, high school bullies, and a torrent of engaging, serial-like side stories - all nested in a larger-than-life fantasy that brings the ultimate evil to a neighborhood near you.

Choose your class, customize your abilities, and battle nightmarish creatures as you collect unique gear in order to infiltrate the massive lairs of Demon lords that have taken over the town.

games.name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition
games.summary:
The critically-acclaimed, story-driven Marvel adventure, now optimized for Nintendo Switch 2.

Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord leading the unpredictable Guardians from one explosion of chaos to the next. You got this. Probably.

The Encore Edition is exclusive to Switch 2 and includes a new set of outfits for Star-Lord, Drax, Gamora, Rocket and Groot. Dressed in 1980s glam rock threads, the Guardians are ready to bring down the house. Literally.

games.name: Next of Kin: Epiphany
games.summary:
Do you have what it takes to catch "The Epiphany Killer"?

Step into the world of "Next of Kin: Epiphany," where you become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation.

In the thrilling conclusion to the "Next of Kin" trilogy, you'll explore atmospheric locations, interrogate suspects with the powerful new "Expose" system, and unravel the chilling truth behind the notorious "Epiphany Killer".

games.name: Stellar Blade: Complete Edition
games.summary:
The future of humanity is balanced on the edge of a blade. Ravaged by strange, powerful creatures, Earth has been abandoned, and what is left of the decimated human race has fled to a Colony in outer space.

After travelling from the Colony, EVE arrives on the desolate remains of our planet with a clear-cut mission: to save humankind by reclaiming Earth from the Naytiba - the malevolent force that has devastated it.

But as EVE tackles the Naytiba one-by-one, piecing together the mysteries of the past in the ruins of human civilization, she realizes that her mission is far from straightforward. In fact, almost nothing is as it seems...

Engage in blisteringly fast combat as you slash a path through the remnants of Earth. Unleash graceful yet brutal attacking combos, unlock new moves and weapon upgrades, and face epic boss encounters that will challenge both brain and brawn in equal measure.

Unravel a gripping human fate story, with mature themes, a thought-provoking narrative and emotionally-charged revelations from beginning to end.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
games.summary: The battle for Hyrule begins. The evil Ganondorf is scheming to steal the mythical Triforce from the Sacred Realm and take over the world. Now Link must become the hero of time and save the kingdom in this classic tale, built from the ground up for the Nintendo Switch 2 system. Enjoy completely overhauled visuals, voiced cutscenes, expanded dialogue, and symphonic orchestral music. You can also jump and dash through the action with enhanced controls and modern camera movements, making this an excellent entry point into the Legend of Zelda™ series.

games.name: Where the Seeds Fall
games.summary: - Fast pace gaming and easy to play- Wonderful graphics- Advanced multipliers mean you get the best wins possible- Auto Hold Feature: Video Poker Classic holds the cards for you! Our finely tuned auto algorithm determines your best chances at success and automatically holds your cards. You can change that of course and take a risk at grabbing the big bucksStart playing and be entertained for hours

games.name: Yomawari: Lost in the Dark
games.summary:
To break a curse placed upon her, a young girl must venture into the haunted streets of her town at night to search for her lost memories while evading
the twisted spirits that lurk in the darkness.

games.name: Yomawari: The Long Night Collection
games.summary: Twice the fright. Traverse the haunting world of Yomawari: Night Alone as a young girl searches for her sister, then share in the terror facing schoolgirls Yui and Haru in Yomawari: Midnight Shadows. Uncover the mysteries plaguing a rural Japanese town, hide from the things lurking in the night, and maybe get home alive.

games.name: Citizen Sleeper: Helion Collection
games.summary:
The Helion Collection brings together the award-winning Citizen Sleeper, a gripping adventure inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, which has you living the life of an escaped worker as you attempt to survive on a lawless space station and its sequel, Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector, a dice-driven RPG where you get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt.
About Citizen Sleeper
Roleplaying in the ruins of interplanetary capitalism. Live the life of an escaped worker, washed-up on a lawless station at the edge of an interstellar society. Inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, explore the station, choose your friends, escape your past and change your future.
About Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector
A dice-driven RPG, in a human and heartfelt sci-fi world. You are an escaped android, with a malfunctioning body, a price on your head and no memory of your past. Get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt.

games.name: Hasbro Games Junior Collection
games.summary:
Get ready for a big, colorful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

Race around the board in Monopoly Jr., where every dice roll can help you grab cool places, collect money, and become the last player standing. Put on your detective hat in Clue Jr. as you search for clues, cross off suspects, and solve the case before anyone else! Then jump into The Game of Life Jr., spin the spinner, drive your car along the path, and collect stars as you go.

Play on your own or in local multiplayer for up to 4 players on one console. Create your own adorable avatar and make it truly yours with fun customization options and unlock new looks and cosmetic rewards just by playing matches.

Easy to learn and packed with exciting moments every round, it’s perfect for family game nights, friendly competition, and big smiles from start to finish!

games.name: Sora - Oasis Treasures
games.summary:
Embark on a breathtaking journey through the jungle skies in Sora - Oasis Treasures. Play as a vibrant parrot and soar across tropical islands, dense canopies, waterfalls, and ancient ruins. Your goal is simple yet meaningful: stay close to your flock as you all travel across the wild, untouched archipelago. 

Each of the handcrafted levels features 40–60 sky markers guiding your path as your flock leads the way. Fly through wind boosts to gain speed, discover hidden shortcuts, and enjoy the feeling of freedom as you glide above treetops and turquoise waters. The world is full of life and color, rewarding you with beautiful vistas and relaxing moments of harmony in flight. 
Though the skies are peaceful, you must stay alert—fall too far behind, and you risk losing the flock. Crashes don’t punish you harshly; you simply return to the most recent waypoint and continue your journey. The focus is on enjoying the adventure, soaking in the serene atmosphere, and experiencing the thrill of flying together. 

With smooth controls, gentle pacing, and vibrant flocks that vary in speed each run, every flight feels fresh. Whether you're racing through the breeze or drifting lazily over a jungle river, Sora - Oasis Treasures offers a warm, relaxing escape into tropical skies where unity and exploration take center stage

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.summary:
Warhammer Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite survivors' game, pitting a host of iconic Warhammer characters against endless hordes of enemies from multiple Warhammer factions. 

Developed by Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors), discover the universes of Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar in all its pixel glory in this new surviv-a-ton.

games.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
games.summary: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

games.name: BALL x PIT: Risen Ballbylon
games.summary:
You’re used to the lift descending into the depths of the pit – but now it’s going up. In this massive expansion for smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite BALL x PIT, rise above the abyss to reach Risen Ballbylon, which floats high in the sky above. Each level is a layer of the former city, where the population has been warped by the effects of the meteor.

Risen Ballbylon is the biggest and most transformative expansion for BALL x PIT yet, adding a wealth of new characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, buildings, and levels, dramatically expanding the possibilities of a run and introducing fresh new gameplay mechanics to test even the most hardened veterans of the pit. Will you rise to the challenge?

games.name: Fakin' It XL
games.summary:
Fakin’ It XL is all about lying your way to victory. Each round presents a simple prompt to all players on their phone or device like “raise your hand if you’ve ever pretended to like a gift you hated.” Everyone is on the same page – except for the faker, who must act as if they’ve received the same prompt as everyone else. Blend in by bluffing, grilling and deflecting through three rounds of interrogation to rack up points. Who knew that casting suspicion on others could be so personally rewarding?

Fakin’ It XL Features:

    New Hijinks-fueling Questions: Emojinal Damage and Thumb Luck mix things up alongside classic Fakin’ It question types for maximum friend-deceiving scheming:
    Emojional Damage challenges players to phrase their answers in the form of an emoji, such as “the emoji for a perfect gift for your boss” while the Faker only has a general category, like “the emoji of an object.” Now, can the Faker explain why giving their boss a shoe is a great idea.
    Thumb Luck asks everyone to weigh in with a quick thumbs up or down on three opinion-worthy items in a row, like “Working from Home” or “Dogs in Costumes”. The Faker has to choose without knowing the subject, though—can they justify their support for “Singing Along With Musicals”?
    Enhanced Remote Play: New options let your avatar take action for you, so the game works just as well on a video call as it does in your living room.
    XL-sized Parties: Now up to eight players can join the same game, making for the rowdiest Fakin’ It sessions ever. Good thing there’s plenty of new avatar choices for everyone to choose from, too.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio
games.summary:
From the creative minds behind Persona 3, 4, and 5 comes Metaphor: ReFantazio, a unique fantasy world, where your protagonist will journey alongside his fairy companion, Gallica, to lift the curse from the kingdom’s lost prince. Control your destiny, face your fears and awaken magical "Archetype" powers that lie dormant in your heart. By awakening to an “Archetype,” you will unlock the power to channel and combine the abilities of unique job classes. Strengthen your bonds and build your party to take down powerful foes and discover the kingdom’s true nature.

-Go on uests, dungeon dive, & hunt for treasures by day. Strengthen relationships, build bonds, & increase virtues by night. Choose your actions wisely, time management is key to achieving your goal. 

Ride your “gauntlet runner” to faraway dungeons & towns across an expansive world. Discover beautiful landscapes  accompanied by captivating music, immersive UI, & anime cutscenes.

A unique battle system combining turn based & real time action grants strategy & exhilaration at every turn. Party customization through “Archetypes” provides freedom to personalize your adventure. 

A mysterious & exciting story unfolds in a world where people must fight their own anxiety. Join the high-stakes Royal Tournament that promises hours of captivating exploration and discovery.

games.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
games.summary:
Moomin: Midsummer Madness is a delightfully playful point-and-click adventure inspired by Tove Jansson’s cherished Nordic fantasy novel, Moominsummer Madness. 

Play as Moomintroll and Little My as they explore a curious old theatre caught in a great flood. The journey will be filled with endearing encounters, familiar faces, and a touch of mischief.

games.name: Pikmin 4: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy
games.summary:
Guide plantlike Pikmin on an enhanced expedition!

Meet Pikmin: small, plantlike creatures you can grow, pluck, guide, and send into battle with creatures multiple times their size! These loyal, curious helpers come in different types, including fire-resistant Red Pikmin, Ice Pikmin that can freeze bodies of water, and Glow Pikmin that can light the way forward at night. 

Dandori is the art of commanding your Pikmin effectively, and sometimes explorers like to get in on some friendly competition.

The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of the game features Dandori Academy, an extensive series of Dandori exam stages for you to test your skill and earn in-game medals! A total of 72 stages will be released over time - and they vary in difficulty, so you can choose the ones that match your skill level.

games.name: Sonic Pico Park
games.summary:
The latest entry in the PICO PARK series is a collaboration with SEGA's Sonic the Hedgehog!

Sonic the Hedgehog, celebrating its 35th anniversary this year, joins the latest entry in the PICO PARK series, a series that has sold over 8 million copies worldwide.

PICO CAT, the iconic character of the PICO PARK series, races through the world of PICO PARK with Sonic, the world’s fastest hedgehog, and his friends, including Tails, Knuckles, and Amy.

games.name: Ravenswatch
games.summary:
Ravenswatch is a top-down roguelike action game that combines intense real-time combat with deep gameplay and high replay value.

After the success of Curse of the Dead Gods, Passtech returns with a new formula and game experience that can be played solo or with up to four players in co-op.

To defeat the Nightmare and reach the final chapter, you will need a strong build, focus and excellent teamwork. Increase your fighting power in battles then face the level boss when you feel ready... or when you no longer have a choice.

games.name: Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator
games.summary: Combine 2 pics...  What do you get?!?!  Can you guess the word?A fun and challenging game that is sure to entertain you for hours and hours!Highlights:- Over 100 addictive levels- New categories to play- Ask for help to advance faster in the game

games.name: Goat Simulator 3: Ticket to Dizzyworld
games.summary:
Welcome to Dizzyworld. An immersive goat-themed baa-musement park, letting you reach higher ups and downs than your mood swings. 

Did you manage to save the Multiverse AND survive the apocalypse?

Take a well-deserved break and feel the g(oat)-force on the many thrilling rides the park has to offer, turn innocent visitors into baalloons, watch them puke, and trade Dizzy Tokens for sweet rewards. 

Sounds like vacation to me. 

Secure your ticket today, enjoy the dizziness later.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
games.summary: With development of the next entry in the Grand Theft Auto series well underway, the Rockstar Games team is determined to once again set creative benchmarks for the series, our industry, and for all entertainment, just as the label has done with every one of their frontline releases.

games.name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance + Online
games.summary:
For the first time ever on console, descend together. The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ brings the complete game to console with full online cooperative play for up to four players. Every character, every item, every path, every ending, now with friends online.

Key Features

    Full online cooperative play for up to four players, on console.
    The complete game: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth plus all downloadable content (“Afterbirth,” “Afterbirth+,” “Repentance,” and “Repentance+”).
    Hundreds of items, dozens of characters and endlessly randomized runs.
    Rebalanced items and improvements from years of updates.

games.name: Gothic 3
games.summary: You have saved the island Khorinis from the forces of evil in Gothic I and Gothic II. Now it is time to travel to the realms of the mainland. Invading Orcs have enslaved the human kingdom. There are but a few free humans in the icy north and the southern desert and a handful of rebels hiding in the forests and mountains of Midland. You may either join the rebellion or serve the Orcish Usurpers but you will ultimately tip the scales and decide the outcome of the last war to save humanity. There is no simple linear story in Gothic III - every game will be different and unique - but all will ultimately lead to you deciding the fate of Myrtana.

games.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: Danger Mouse
games.summary:
Baron Greenback has fallen on hard times...

Feeling nostalgic for the “bad old days,” Greenback launches his boldest evil plan yet, forcing Danger Mouse and Penfold to re-live all their epic encounters. 

Will Greenback get a second chance at victory, or is this the final game over?

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
games.summary:
Get ready to dive into an entirely new adventure as you become a magical Merfolk and embark on a sweeping journey across the sea to reach a faraway kingdom, where strange echoes of its past await. Along the way, you’ll meet some unforgettable new friends, including Milo Thatch, Captain Jack Sparrow, and Megara, as you uncover the mysteries waiting beyond the waves.

The Keepsake Sea will introduce brand-new Biomes to explore, mysterious underwater areas to uncover, and new spaces to fully customize. From exploring what lies beneath the surface to discovering the secrets of this faraway kingdom, there’s plenty of adventure waiting for you!

games.name: Winx Club: Moonlight Quest
games.summary: Are you sure to know all the logos?Test yourserlf with LogosQuiz and find out how many you know!Challenge your friends and the rest of world with Game Center!With more than 700 logos and 12 levels of fun is guaranteed.

games.name: Hela: of Mice & Magic
games.summary:
Get ready for a cozy journey in "Hela", where you'll step into the tiny paws of a brave mouse, the beloved familiar of a witch who needs your help. 

Wander through an enchanting Scandinavian landscape filled with puzzles to solve, potions to brew, and quests to complete, all to aid your ailing witch. Whether you play alone or with friends, you're in for a treat filled with magic, companionship, and loads of charm.

"Hela" offers a delightful mix of adventure and relaxation. Enjoy exploring vast, open spaces, engaging in light-hearted play, and experiencing the simple pleasure of being a part of a caring community.

games.name: House Flipper 2: Pets
games.summary:
Welcome to Puffin Isle! This slightly neglected region of Pinnacove seems in urgent need of a makeover. From charming villas to forgotten landmarks, these jobs are sure to surprise you! 

Meeting friends old and new, can you help them make this place a cozy haven for all animal lovers? Or will you focus on creating your own pet-centered houses for other players to enjoy?

Learn more about different breeds and species, observe them, and fulfill their needs to see them thrive. Let one of your cats or dogs accompany you during renovations and watch your friends pet them together in the co-op mode. Relax after a day of hard work by playing with your little companions and forge a bond that will last a lifetime.

games.name: SOMBRAS: negative frames
games.summary:
Shiomi Alterio, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, lives with her father in a quaint Japanese town after her parents’ recent divorce, far from the life in Europe she was forced to leave behind.

One night, Shiomi is engulfed by a dark dimension made of familiar streets, hungry shadows, and a cast of girls that look just like her...

Help Shiomi return home by taking pictures of unusual sights, surviving unsettling encounters, and reuniting every single fragment of her broken self.

games.name: Barbie Rewind
games.summary:
Decorate the DreamHouse through the decades, while playing classic Barbie games in this cozy and creative game. Barbie Rewind pulls you back in time through iconic eras of Barbie with stunning pixel art and retro style. Your bestie, Barbie, invites you into her world and entrusts you to update her DreamHouse with your unique style, using items from 65+ years of Barbie history.

Choose from three retro DreamHouse designs for your exterior facade, walls, and floors. You can even mix-and-match them from room to room. Style each room with a fabulous collection of furniture, decor, and accessories, inspired by real Barbie playsets throughout the decades. From a classic pink vanity to a ‘90s inflatable chair, make the DreamHouse unique to your style and creativity.

Barbie has also left you her game collection of 16 Barbie video games from 1991 through 2007. Titles include Barbie Pet Rescue, Barbie Horse Adventures: Blue Ribbon Race, and the never-before-released game, Barbie: Vacation Adventure. Play through the collection to complete additional quests and unlock more items.

games.name: Corpse Party II: Darkness Distortion
games.summary:
Production has been underway on Corpse Party II: Darkness Distortion, an all-new entry and true sequel to the series. 

In a new setting, new horrors await with a cruel laugh. I hope that it will become a source of encouragement for those faced against the harsh realities of the world.

games.name: Crystals Of Irm
games.summary:
Today, only legends surround the crystals of Irm. The red crystal of the mountains - once the fire of the great forge, the blue crystal - once the symbol of the knowledge of the eternal academy and the green crystal - once the patron saint of the endless forests; they have all disappeared from the world for too long. Or maybe not after all?

Time and again, noble warriors set out on the trail of the crystals to return them to their original place. Many have failed so far and the whereabouts are still unclear. The legends speak of three dungeons in which the hearts of Irm are said to be hidden. Will it be possible to retrieve the crystals this time?

Crystals Of Irm is an old school RPG with a distinctive combat system and dungeon crawl elements. With three heroes you explore Irm, visit the different regions of the land and climb deep down into the darkest dungeons.

games.name: Do Not Feed the Monkeys 2099
games.summary: Spy on strangers through security cameras, invade their privacy and discover their secrets in this digital voyeur simulator. Welcome to the future of The Primate Observation Club. Even in 2099 the rule about messing with your unlucky subjects still remains in this sequel: DO NOT feed the monkeys!

games.name: Dumb Ways to Party
games.summary:
Dumb Ways to Party throws contestants into the The Dumbest of the Dumb game show - a whirlwind of wacky challenges, hilarious mishaps, surprise twists, big wins and even bigger fails!

The challenge? Out-dumb the competition and take home the prestigious title of Dumbest of the Dumb!

Are you here for glory? Fame? Or just to make a fool of yourself? Let’s find out!

games.name: FATE: Reawakened - Prometheus
games.summary:
Littered with victories from previous battles, players thought they could rest in the calm after the storm...that is, until Alethe, a mysterious young woman appeared at the Temple of Fate. 

She tells of how Prometheus, a city once blessed by the Gods, has been all but forsaken by them. Erebos, the Titan of Darkness, has thrown the world into chaos by stealing the Golden Flame - a revered gift from the Gods that granted the city’s denizens with knowledge, protection, and everlasting prosperity. 

Now FATE calls upon the player once again, beckoning them forward to reclaim the Golden Flame and save Prometheus from being cast into eternal shadow.

games.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow
LUCID
games.summary:
After the Great Fall and the destruction of the Lucid Giant, the world of Aedyn has succumbed to corruption. Only the dwindling Sentinels are left to guard a fragile balance. As Oenn, you will explore this shattered world and fulfill a solemn promise.

Platform through a crystalline world torn apart by calamity, absorb powerful abilities that expand movement and enhance combat against a diverse cast of enemies and bosses, all in gorgeous pixel art inspired by the golden age of 2D sidescrollers.

games.name: Mago: Hyperdelicious Edition
games.summary:
Mago: Hyperdelicious Edition is a retro-styled 2D platformer with RPG elements, featuring beautiful pixel art, original mechanics and charismatic characters. 

Embark on a thrilling journey as you run, jump, and wield your trusty wand to make your way through 8 vibrant and diverse worlds. Each world boasts its own distinct theme, mechanics, challenging bosses, hidden secrets, and surprisingly original mini-games.

games.name: Rhell: Warped Worlds & Troubled Times
games.summary:
Rhell: Warped Worlds & Troubled Times is a semi-open world puzzle adventure where you play as a loud-mouthed, hot-headed mage trying to figure out why everyone has disappeared. With 40 magical runes to combine however you want, every challenge is an opportunity to create your own solution.

As Rhell, a sharp-tongued mage, you explore forgotten ruins filled with ancient secrets, decode mysterious fragments left behind by those who came before, and slowly piece together what really caused this catastrophe. The few remaining inhabitants have their theories, but you might find a truth far stranger than anyone suspected.

What started as a simple mystery becomes something that challenges everything you thought you knew.

games.name: Slam City with Scottie Pippen: Respect Edition
Toxic Crusaders
games.summary:
When the evil Dr. Killemoff attacks, only one team of hideously deformed creatures of superhuman size and strength stands between him and his plans for global pollution: the Toxic Crusaders, earth's last, greatest and ugliest hope for survival! The hottest heroes of 1991 return for a radical, radioactive beat 'em up for a new era, featuring awesome action, crushing combos and more toxic waste than you'll know what to do with!

Choose from seven playable characters, including Toxie, No-Zone, Junkyard, Major Disaster and Headbanger (who would technically count as two characters if they could only agree on something) - plus, for the first time, play as Toxie's musically "gifted" girlfriend Yvonne, and the mother of all mothers, Mrs. Junko, Toxie's mom!

Battle across seven disgusting levels rendered in beautiful full-color pixel art as you defend Tromaville from hordes of Radiation Rangers, mutated thugs and zombie chickens. The odds might be stacked against you but with awesome powers, a winning personality and up to four-player local co-up on your side, the Smogulan Empire's days are numbered!

Take a deep breath and dive deep into an action-packed, pun-filled adventure that drags you kicking and screaming through the wonderful world of Troma. Enjoy cameos from gore-filled classics such as Class of Nuke 'Em High, Poultrygeist: Night of the Chicken Dead, and Sgt. Kabukiman N.Y.P.D. - reimagined in the Saturday morning cartoon style that made this franchise so unforgettable!

games.name: Toy Tactics
games.summary:
Toy Tactics is an RTS where you can draw unit formations and command units based on minifigs to victory. 

Under the guidance of legendary generals, master the ability to draw configurations into the battlefield and send miniature legions to war against hordes of undead foes. Charge up your army with artifacts and destructive spells to give you the upper hand in battle and smash your foes in real-time. 

Think fast, deploy your units strategically, and lead them to victory!

games.name: Warhammer Blood Bowl
games.summary:
Warhammer Blood Bowl is the official adaptation of the tabletop game of the same name. Based on the latest official rules of the newest edition, it introduces two new factions, the Tomb Kings and the Bretonnians, and delivers a content-rich experience that will continue to evolve after launch through a seasonal system and a competitive ecosystem culminating each year in a highly contested World Championship embraced by the community.

The game will feature 26 factions available at launch, along with numerous competitions and both solo and multiplayer modes. There will be no step back in terms of content or features. Warhammer Blood Bowl builds on the solid foundation of Blood Bowl 3 and stands as the natural successor to the work carried out by the development team during the three years following the release of the previous edition.

games.name: What Do You Meme? The Video Game
Fate/Extra Record
games.summary:
The “Moon Holy Grail War” begins anew...

The setting is a Spiritron virtual world called “SE.RA.PH.” built on the moon. Masters and Servants team up and fight for survival in pursuit of the “Holy Grail,” an omnipotent wish-granting device, in the Moon Holy Grail War which begins once again…

This is a remake of Fate/EXTRA, the first Fate series RPG originally released on July 22, 2010, now revamped for modern hardware with an expanded scenario, refreshed character graphics, and dramatic command battles utilizing a highly strategic deck-building system.

games.name: My Arms Are Longer Now
games.summary: My Arms Are Longer Now is a 2D stealth-comedy game. With your disgusting long arm, you’ll avoid security systems, steal whatever isn’t bolted down, put a sock on your hand and flirt with a lonely guard - whatever it takes to pull off the perfect heist!

games.name: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
games.summary:
Play as Garrett, an orphan rescued from the streets by the Keepers—a secretive, ancient order dedicated to maintaining balance in the world - and trained to become a Master Thief. Using minimal weapons and maximum stealth, you must keep to the shadows and move quietly to complete missions and collect treasure without too many casualties. 

In Thief: The Dark Project Remastered, Nightdive Studios brings back the pioneering 3D stealth game from Looking Glass Studios. Described by its developers as a “first-person sneaker,” the 1998 title challenged norms with its non-confrontational gameplay at a time when most first-person games prioritized combat. 

Remastered with Nightdive’s KEX Engine, the release includes Thief: The Dark Project and the additional missions, content and updates from the 1999 Thief Gold re-release. Explore unscripted, maze-like levels with advanced NPCs, who can hear, speak, and sound alarms if you make a wrong move. Each mission includes 3 difficulty settings with different objectives for maximum replayability.

games.name: Mega Man: Dual Override
games.summary:
Mega Man returns in 2027 with a brand-new entry in the classic action platforming series!

Override challenges and blast down legions of robots while springboarding across a new array of futuristic frontiers!

games.name: POSTAL 2 Redux
games.summary:
You’ve got a week’s worth of errands. Buy some milk. Return an overdue library book. Maybe get Gary Coleman’s autograph. Simple enough, right? But this is POSTAL 2 Redux - where a normal day can spiral into absolute carnage at a moment’s notice, and the only thing more unpredictable than your to-do list is the lunatic freakshow that calls this town home.

For the first time ever, POSTAL 2 is fully reimagined for the new generation, bringing its dark humor, open-world mayhem, and unapologetic absurdity to an entirely new level. 

Step into the well-worn boots of The POSTAL Dude, a hapless everyman just trying to get through the week in the bizarre town of Paradise, Arizona. 

Whether you choose to play it cool or go completely POSTAL is entirely up to you.

games.name: DECAPOLICE
games.summary:
DECAPOLICE, a crime-suspense RPG from Level-5, developers of the Layton series, will be released in 2023!

The main character, a rookie detective named Harvard, hunts down criminals in a huge open-world crime-ridden city, travelling back and forth between physical and virtual reality.

Look forward to a mysterious detective story with investigations in virtual space.

games.name: Dragon Slayer: The Legend of Heroes I & II
games.summary:
The PC Engine version of Dragon Slayer: The Legend of Heroes, originally released in 1991 as the sixth entry in the Dragon Slayer series, is officially making a comeback on modern platforms! 

The PC Engine version added main character voice acting in select scenes, allowing players to immerse themselves even deeper into its grand story.

games.name: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
games.summary:
Eternia’s favorite heroes including He-Man, Teela, Man-At-Arms and more in a two-player, retro-inspired 2D magic-brawler, drawn in beautiful pixel-art and featuring huge, highly-detailed sprites, designed to do justice to Eternia’s favorite peace-keepers.

He-Man, Teela, and Man-At-Arms do battle over 12 sprawling and diverse levels of non-stop action, armed with a host of moves, abilities, and power-ups as they work to stop Skeletor’s ancient ritual that threatens to plunge Eternia into darkness!

games.name: Okko The Exiled
games.summary:
Okko The Exiled is an action-packed adventure where you stomp, launch, and bash your way through Kutala, a land of demons, on a quest to defeat the Demon Lord Yalda and link Okko’s isolated world with the heavens.

After 1,000 years of concealment, Okko is ready to wield the Mighty Fang and take down Kutala’s lords one by one. 

Defeat powerful foes, overcome obstacles, and unleash your heart as Okko fights to fulfill an ancient oath.

games.name: Villion:Code
games.summary:
In the near future, humanity stands on the verge of extinction.

One day, a “strange phenomenon” occurs in the Adhvan Resilience Research Academy City, which was established to deal with the impending doom.

Monstrous creatures known as “GEMs” begin attacking people, and at the same time the academy city is sealed off by a mysterious “bubble,” leaving no means of escape to the outside.

In this closed and desperate situation, each person is forced to confront the “karma” they bear.

What is the truth behind the strange phenomenon surrounding the academy city?
